games.desc: Wild Warfare is a F2P, multiplayer FPS made for players that enjoy fun and/or being a bear. It's a mix of crazy game modes, balanced classes, simple controls and intense matches. Its got vehicle combat, because why not? You can even be a bunny that clubs people with a wrench, lucky you.

games.name: METAL SLUG DEFENSE
games.desc: "METAL SLUG" возвращается в виде новой стратегической игры на Steam!

games.name: Trials on Tatooine
games.desc: Commence your Jedi training in this Star Wars virtual reality demo experience. Repair the Millennium Falcon, defend it from attack by Imperial Stormtroopers, and wield a LIGHTSABER.

games.name: Genesis Online
games.desc: Genesis Online! First Person Multiplayer Adventure game in an editable procedural cubic world.

games.name: Timore Inferno
games.desc: Timore Inferno is the 4th indie horror game in the Timore series. Strange visitors have come to a little girl's house, robbing her home and killing everyone inside... Except her. With dolls holding the anger of her loss, everyone who tries to go there and investigate what happened wind up missing.

games.name: Lone Leader
games.desc: Lone Leader это зомби-апокалиптическая игра на выживание. Выжить - вот единственная цель вашей жизни. Исследуйте кошмарный мир от первого лица и убейте всех врагов в городе. И как только будете готовы - бегите из города прочь. Приготовьтесь к жутким моментам и разным страшилкам.

games.name: Claws & Feathers 2
games.desc: Помогите птицам вернуть украденную котами карту сокровищ! Вас ждет веселое пиратское приключение и море удовольствия!

games.name: Clad in Iron: Philippines 1898
games.desc: Управляйте своим флотом и армией, стройте береговые сооружения и транспортные суда, укрывайте свои эскадры кораблей в защищенных портах до прибытия подкреплений, блокируйте вражеские порты и торговые пути, высаживайте десанты, сражайтесь за господство над морями.

games.name: Race With Ryan
games.desc: Ryan’s World ожил, и каждый его пиксель дышит цветом, радость и скоростью. Поэтому выбирай гонщика, отправляйся в одну из шести волшебных локаций и жми на газ, чтобы показать друзьям и близким, кто на свете всех быстрее!

games.name: Samurai Chess
games.desc: The classical game of chess... now with samurai warriors! Play chess against your friends or versus the computer, unlock new scenarios and chess pieces, and prove yourself to be a real samurai.

games.name: Star Shift Origins
games.desc: Звезда Сдвиг Происхождение рассказывает историю первого экипажа корабля Донтлесс. Оказавшись в западне в альтернативной реальности и находясь в бегах, экипаж отчаянно ищет ответы, пытаясь уйти от преследования неумолимого Альянса Земельных Систем (ESA).

games.name: Die Again
games.desc: Смеешь ли ты бросить вызов этому безумному экшену, где проверишь свою стратегию и выживаемость? Подсказка: ты можешь обмануть смерть… если рядом есть кто-то! Добраться до Нулевой Зоны получится?

games.name: Pizza Hero
games.desc: Pizza Hero — это уникальный shoot 'em up roguelike. Выбранные вами топпинги влияют на ваши способности. Например, пепперони бросает гранаты, а голубой сыр создает едкий периметр.

games.name: GASP
games.desc: This game takes place in the same universe as our upcoming tittle Secluded; you take control of a lone astronaut that lands on the surface of a planet, miles away from the other members. And it’s your job to meet up with the other astronauts.

games.name: ChuSingura46+1 S
games.desc: ChuSingura46+1S is an award-winning Japanese visual novel set in an alternate Edo Japan where all the Samurai are inexplicably female. You can get to know the “intimate” side of the characters from the classic Japanese tale of the 47 Ronin, all without any of the dangly or rough bits of the original!

games.name: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms
games.desc: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms — это стратегия в мире Dungeons & Dragons, где воители из разных уголков мультивселенной D&D отправляются в грандиозные приключения.

games.name: 天际起源 The Ark of Horizon
games.desc: The Ark of Horizon is a boldly creative Battle Royale game. Multidimensional battlegrounds are adopted. The combat take place anywhere up to the air or down to the sea. In the Ark of Horizon, you can fly, adventure and combat just like a super hero!

games.name: PrprLive
games.desc: PrPrive is a Live2D live broadcast assistant software developed by us. The software can achieve a high frame rate, multi-expression switching, targetless auto-drop frame at a lower CPU occupancy.

games.name: Failure simulator
games.desc: Waste time like in real life, do absolutely nothing watch your screen while you wonder were did things go wrong in your life. A simulation game that you do nothing just look at your screen. A complete waste of time and money.

games.name: Atomic Owl
games.desc: You are Hidalgo Bladewing, a bird with a beef. Hack, slash, platform, and soar through a beautifully chaotic pixel-art neonscape in your quest to save your feathered friends. Challenging retro-inspired platforming gameplay, transforming weapons, and fowl Ninja action await.

games.name: Depression Quest
games.desc: Depression Quest is an interactive fiction game where you play as someone living with depression. You are given a series of everyday life events and have to attempt to manage your illness, relationships, job, and possible treatment.

games.name: Golf Tour
games.desc: Golf Tour — игра, сделанная компанией друзей для таких же друзей. Забавные абсурдные локации, где, кроме стандартных препятствий, вас ждут и неровности дизайна уровней. Рисуйте на мячах что угодно, проявите свое остроумие. Некоторые баги мы возвели в разряд фич, также ради вашего веселья.

games.name: The Lost Mythologies
games.desc: The Lost Mythologies is a Chinese styled action game with intense combat. Use various skills to defeat loads of enemies, explore the ruins of the fallen empire and finally face the notorious ancient weapon - the Black Rakshasa.

games.name: Nyctophobia
games.desc: Your truck is wrecked, your flashlight is dimming and darkness surrounds you. Your fears come alive. Get to the generator and bring back the light before “The Keeper” finds you.

games.name: Vampire Hunter: Nightrise
games.desc: Ты заперт в готическом замке вампира. Найди потайные ходы и доберись до хозяина замка до наступления Nightrise. Круши мебель на колья, пришпиливай тварей к стенам арбалетом для кольев и береги веру — она даёт тебе силу.

games.name: Desktop Golf
games.desc: Уютная, расслабляющая игра в мини-гольф, которая плавает прямо на вашем рабочем столе. Без полноэкранного режима, без отвлекающих факторов — просто мирные удары, когда захотите. Идеально подходит для перерывов, фоновой игры и развлечения без стресса.

games.name: Scrap Garden - The Day Before
games.desc: Маленький ржавый робот C4N, сам того не желая, постоянно оказывается участником судьбоносных событий для Города Роботов. Чтобы разгадать новую загадку, Кенни снова предстоит много бегать и прыгать, решать головоломки и вступать в драку с противниками, превосходящими его числом и размерами.

games.name: Realm Royale Reforged
games.desc: Станьте лучшим чемпионом в Realm Royale! Наделите вашего персонажа смертоносными способностями и оружием. Исследуйте волшебный мир верхом и спаситесь от губительного тумана. Вас ждет впечатляющая королевская битва с участием 100 игроков!

games.name: FORZA POLPO!
games.desc: Jump high. Glide far. Blast weird robots. Polpo is a fast, vertical FPS platformer with pure ‘90s energy

games.name: Wilderplace
games.desc: Wilderplace is a turn-based spatial puzzle game where gameplay and narrative are intertwined. Explore the maze-like environment, harness magical artifacts, and uncover mysteries as you wrangle restless spirits and evade dangerous intruders on a quest to bring balance to the Divine Garden.

games.name: Manager can be Tough!: Case of the Kidnapped Waitress
games.desc: Hack, slash, and blast your way through hordes of beastly enemies and powerful bosses to rescue your beautiful waitress in this sexy 2D Side scrolling action game!

Ролевая игра с нажатием и щелчком, полная головоломок и жестоких врагов. Вы можете решить быть добрым или злым в игре. Ваши решения определят ваше будущее. Используйте свои предметы разумно или понесите последствия. “Пока я думал, что учусь жить, я учился умирать”. - Леонардо да Винчи

games.name: SGS Imjin War
games.desc: Книга «Имджинская война» рассказывает об одном из самых ожесточенных конфликтов конца XVI века, изображающем вторжение японцев в Корейское королевство Чосон с 1592 по 1598 год.

games.name: Electronic Market Simulator
games.desc: Управляйте своим магазином электроники: нанимайте персонал, управляйте финансами, берите кредиты и инвестируйте в криптовалюты. Обрабатывайте онлайн-заказы, ешьте, расширяйте здание и превратите маленький магазин в крупный технологический бренд!

games.name: AX:EL - Air XenoDawn
games.desc: Combining the very best of sci-fi and aerial dogfighting gameplay, AX:EL delivers a totally new gaming experience. Create your very own shape-shifting vehicle and dominate both the sky and the ocean.

games.name: Heckabomb
games.desc: Explosive twin stick shooter. Lots of upgrades. Full controller support. Awesome soundtrack.

games.name: Sokker
games.desc: Sokker is a fast-paced soccer game for 1-4 players! ⚽ Kick by flicking the control stick! 🦶🏻 Play your friends in Versus mode, or try co-op in the World Cup! 🏆

games.name: Sumire's Secret
games.desc: When Sumire's teacher develops a one-sided obsession with her, her day-to-day becomes a 24/7 horror story without a hero... only victims and villains.

games.name: Edge of Twilight – Return To Glory
games.desc: "Edge of Twilight - Return to Glory" - приключенческая игра от 3 лица в постапокалитическом стимпанковом фэнтэзи сеттинге, которая поведает о мире, разделённом на два измерения: дневное и ночное.

games.name: Trimmer Tycoon
games.desc: Trimmer Tycoon is a fast survival game. You’re the new owner of a beard-trimming salon - Shavy. Customers start flowing in with absurd wishes for their beards. Can you satisfy their beardy dreams and keep up with the ever-increasing rent?

games.name: Epic Battle Fantasy 3
games.desc: Epic Battle Fantasy 3 is a silly turn-based JRPG, full of useless NPCs, rabid cats, childish humor, unreasonably large weapons, anime boobs, and other nonsense. And it's totally free!

games.name: Дорогой Король Величество
games.desc: Dear Princes and Princess, a legendary kingdom awaits your inheritance. Your people eagerly await your wisdom and courage. Yet, this journey is fraught with challenges; obstacles will test your resolve. Do not betray the trust your people have in you. Lead them to true greatness!

games.name: Battle Islands
games.desc: Battle friends over air, land and sea in this epic WW2-themed battle strategy game.

games.name: Hit of Chernobyl
games.desc: Hit of Chernobyl - это игра в жанре Survival FPS. Действия происходят в Зоне отчуждения, которая была сильно загрязнена после таинственной катастрофы. Спустя много лет, в Зону стали проникать мародёры, журналисты и другие авантюристы. Эти люди стали создавать группировки для вылазок вглубь Зоны.

games.name: It's time to get out from the solar system
games.desc: A game with a futuristic anti-utopian story — a hardcore space shooter with RPG elements.

games.name: Music Maker Steam Edition
games.desc: Simply create music - with Music Maker 2020. Now free.

games.name: Dragon Nest
games.desc: Dragon Nest is an online action role-playing game that combines the blazingly fast combat and visually stunning attacks of a console game with the epic story and role-playing elements of classic MMORPGs.

games.name: Rhythmic Retro Racer
games.desc: Rhythmic Retro Racer — ритм-игра в загадочной ретро-комнате 90-х. Погрузитесь в мощный синтвейв и оттачивайте точность на вручную созданных уровнях. С ростом напряжения вы осознаете: это не просто игра, а часть мрачного эксперимента. Испытайте идеальный ритм и атмосферу психологического триллера.

games.name: Silent
games.desc: Это другой способ почувствовать эмоцию страха. Во время игры даже малейший звук заставит вас начать игру с самого начала. Пока вы пытаетесь раскрыть загадочное дело, на лесной дороге вы попадаете в аварию. Вы должны найти выход из леса.

games.name: Lost Lands: Stories about the Sorceress, the Prince and the Minotaur Collector's Edition
games.desc: “Lost Lands: Stories about the Sorceress, the Prince and the Minotaur” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

games.name: Null Hørizøn
games.desc: Survive the void in Null Hørizøn. Trade, fight, and explore a retro-futuristic 3D galaxy with 2D sprites. Upgrade your ship, smuggle goods, and travel across the universe. Tactical Real-Time combat meets Grid-based exploration in this atmospheric space sim. The Null Hørizøn calls, Captain.

games.name: Crush Online
games.desc: Crush Online is a Free-to-Play PVP MMO with MOBA-style combat in a persistent world. Choose between one of three factions and many distinct characters with tons of different weapon setups. CRUSH ONLINE isn’t just a match. It’s WAR!

games.name: Minds Eyes
games.desc: You venture through your mind, trying desperately to wake up from your nightmares. Will you make it out?

games.name: Future Proof
games.desc: Quirky, top-down puzzle adventure game. You’re trapped in a 12-minute time loop. Try to save yourself and a small town from destruction from a meteorite. Solve intuitive puzzles, interact with the people of the town, and discover the secrets of the town. Discover the 15 different endings!

games.name: Walking Zombie 2
games.desc: Одиночный шутер про зомби с крутой многоугольной графикой и элементами RPG.

games.name: Victory At Sea Ironclad
games.desc: Victory at Sea Ironclad is the exciting game of naval RTS combat set during the American Civil War. Bringing an epic approach to real time strategy war gaming, search and destroy enemy fleets across an open world sandbox in a desperate attempt to change the course of history.

games.name: Coloring Game 4
games.desc: Четвёртая игра франшизы Coloring Game (закраска по номерам). Для поклонников серии представлен обновлённый функционал игры и множество новых картинок.

games.name: Scholar of the Arcane Arts
games.desc: Scholar of the Arcane Arts — это Roguelike ролевой боевик, в котором ваша жизнь полностью зависит от понимания магии. Изучайте заклинания, решайте головоломки, открывайте тайные подземелья и побеждайте жутких существ, чтобы спасти мир от вторжения Пяти измерений магии!

games.name: BTD:BTD
games.desc: Простой однопользовательский тактический шутер высокой сложности.

games.name: Project Breakout
games.desc: Project Breakout это симулятор побега из тюрьмы, в котором ты и до трёх друзей окажетесь за решёткой и попытаетесь выбраться на свободу.Исследуй территорию, тренируй свои характеристики и собирай предметы, чтобы создавать инструменты и оружие для побега.

games.name: Soccer Manager 2017
games.desc: Soccer Manager 2017 - Play for Free, Compete for Real. The most diverse FREE 2 PLAY football management simulator in the world. Take on a top flight club and test your management skills against the best or help a struggling, lower division team fight for glory.

games.name: Island Saver
games.desc: Небольшой архипелаг удивительных островов нуждается в твоей помощи! На берег выбросило массу пластиковых отходов, и тебе необходимо разобраться с этим при помощи верного мусорбластера! Но будь осторожен - там могут быть мусорики. Они обожают беспорядок и любят всё портить.

games.name: Age of Conquest IV
games.desc: Age of Conquest - пошаговый варгейм.

games.name: Horizon Shift
games.desc: Horizon Shift is an explosive wave based single screen shooter with a ton of new ideas and platformer elements. Do what it takes to protect your horizon from the ever encroaching enemy attack!

games.name: WEED SHOP SIMULATOR
games.desc: Weed Shop Simulator launches in Early Access! 🌿 Build your cannabis empire from seed to sale. Grow rare strains, craft legendary products, hire your team, and outsmart rivals in a chaotic world full of wild adventures and deep cannabis culture. Your empire awaits!

games.name: The shaved ice shop
games.desc: Уютная хоррор-игра, в которой вы управляете лавкой с колотым льдом. Обслуживайте клиентов, предлагая колотый лед, кофе, молочные коктейли...

games.name: The SeethingSwarm Collection
games.desc: A curated anthology of classic Flash games by SeethingSwarm. Play 25+ games from the golden age of the web — preserved just as they were, with fullscreen support (F11) — all launched through a console-style retro menu.

games.name: Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim
games.desc: At long last, the works of H.P. Lovecraft meet the medium of RPG in a spectacle of light and sound befitting an old western. Only this is set in New England. Meet interesting people! See astounding wonders! Enslave humanity! Go on one date side quest in a game subtitled a dating simulator!

games.name: DONG WU: ODYSSEY
games.desc: Бесконечное путешествие Аннимов — хардкорная RPG о зверях. Отряд из 4 героев, война за трон длиной в тысячу лет. Враги — интриги или чёрная скверна. Жизнь одна: падение или превосхождение — всё решает миг. Выжить помогут стратегия, удача и смелость.

games.name: Long Car Journey - A road trip game
games.desc: Traverse the never-ending desert searching for provisions. Look for fuel, fix the engine, pay attention to the battery, change the turbo charger! Explore abandoned buildings, sell the objects you find, check the condition of your car. Collect provisions and hide them at home!

games.name: King and Kingdoms
games.desc: Factions, countries and empires that have truly existed in the real history await you. The only difference is that it is in your hand to rewrite their history. Become the ruler of any country you want and lead your nation from small village to the way to be the magnificent empire!

games.name: 东方冰之勇者记：序章
games.desc: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy Prologue is a fanmade indie game developed by GAMEPULSE.To save the Princess of Misty Lake "Daiyousei", from the evil who took her captive. You must play as the brave Hero of Ice Fairy "Cirno" and face "Remilia Scarlet" of the Kouma Castle

games.name: Anarchy Arcade
games.desc: Turn your entire digital life into a game. AArcade is a 3D desktop that launches shortcuts to absolutely anything you like. Join the anarchy of the persistent online metaverse, or remain in your own private reality. Casual in-game building features, plus hundreds of thousands of addons.

games.name: The Corridor: On Behalf Of The Dead
games.desc: Step into the fractured mind of a killer. Alone and unarmed, uncover evidence inside distorted memories as you solve puzzles and confront the horror inside the psyche of the accused.

games.name: Copa Petrobras de Marcas
games.desc: COPA PETROBRAS DE MARCAS is a 100% free official game simulating the thrill of competing wheel-to-wheel with models from various automakers in some of the main Brazilian race tracks.

games.name: CastleOn
games.desc: Build a castle! Grow economy, recruit troops from Europe and the Holy Land, man the walls and towers! Place traps and defeat attackers with arrows, wood and stone, fire, disease and cold steel! Survive the Third Crusade and conquer enemy lands in Castleon!

games.name: ShareX
games.desc: ShareX is a free and open source program that can capture or record selected area from the screen with a single keypress, automatically save them to your hard disk/clipboard, and instantly upload them to an image/file hosting service and then can copy the URL to your clipboard.

games.name: Warfront Defenders
games.desc: The gameplay is inspired by famous last stands from some of history's deadliest conflicts, such as the Second World War and the Sino-Japanese War. A hybrid of Tower Defense and Real-Time Strategy with a lot of replay value.

games.name: Metal War Online: Retribution
games.desc: Fast Online Car Shooter. Unmatched dynamic shooter with a huge selection of futuristic technology! Millions of players.

games.name: RoBoRumble
games.desc: Build powerful battle robots from components like Chassis, Weapon and Booster. The battle’s starting and you’re right in it – with freely definable camera perspectives, spectacular effects, unlimited zoom and scroll, colored light sources, terrain morphing and 3D sound. Pure action – pure excitement!

games.name: Football Fictional World Simulator
games.desc: Текстовый футбольный менеджер, посвящённый трансферам и подготовке состава к сезону. Симулируйте около 30 000 матчей за десять минут, редактируйте данные и наблюдайте за историей футбола на протяжении столетий.

games.name: Epic Roller Coasters
games.desc: Epic Roller Coasters — это самые уникальные американские горки в мире. В игре три режима: классический, стрельба и гонка. Обязательно пригласите друзей прокатиться на любимых трассах вместе с вами.

games.name: OpenTTD
games.desc: OpenTTD - это экономический симулятор, в котором игроки зарабатывают деньги, перевозя пассажиров и грузы с помощью автомобильного, железнодорожного, водного и воздушного транспорта.

games.name: Office No.41: Prototype Edition
games.desc: A prototype version of upcoming horror game "Office No.41". James Loderick goes to closed specialized music school '' Lim Donna '', in which he studied to find and take something that could make his dream come true. But right after he comes to school, he realizes that something is not alright.

games.name: Occulto
games.desc: Occulto is a non-verbal, entirely hand-drawn point-and-click adventure unlike other games in the genre. Guide Eliot through an atmospheric fairy-tale world where mysteries are solved without a single word. Its purely visual storytelling offers an experience unlike traditional point-and-click games

games.name: 8/8/88 Needle AL
games.desc: On the ominous date of 8/8/1888, the entire population of Needle, Alabama seemingly vanished, leaving behind only a haunting silence and an eerie sense of dread. A first-person psychological-horror drama.

games.name: Ragnarok Online 2
games.desc: Return to the beautiful and dangerous world of Midgard! Inspired by Norse mythology, the much-anticipated sequel to the groundbreaking Ragnarok Online has arrived! Immerse yourself in the new, but recognizable world of Ragnarok 2.

games.name: MARVEL Puzzle Quest
games.desc: Collect Marvel characters and upgrade your unstoppable squad in this epic Super Hero Puzzle RPG! Fight on the tactical Match-3 board where every move is crucial, and master head-to-head PvP tournaments alongside high-stakes events all year round!

games.name: Cubetractor
games.desc: WINNER: IGF China award for BEST GAME!Cubetractor is a neo-retroesque action-strategy-puzzle hybrid where you defeat enemies through an unconventional cube-pulling, turret-buildling mechanic. The game carries elements of a reverse tower defence and a grounded bullet-hell dodger to deliver a unique gameplay…

games.name: Speedollama
games.desc: Speedollama — это скоростной платформер-шутер, устанавливающий новый стандарт скорости в жанре. Наполненная необычным юмором и ярким пиксельным месивом, эта игра не для слабонервных. Готовы ли вы принять хаос и доказать свои навыки?

games.name: Ant Farm Simulator
games.desc: Ant farm (formicarium) with a colony of ants. Ants have artificial intelligence that mimics the full life cycle, behavior, nature and physics of real insects.

games.name: Streng Check
games.desc: A classic runner is waiting for you, in which you will visit dangerous streets and ordeals. The character is in the territory contaminated with radiation, so in order to survive, you will have to collect an antidote! Pass the strength test and exceed your results to see the whole dangerous world of our game!

games.name: The Forgotten Ones
games.desc: Losing his parents during the holocaust to a mad man of a doctor. You're to play as Grobuskna Vladinov, 20 years after the incident that changed his life dramatically. Grobuskna receives an unknown phone call that'll start a journey that'll twist your mind...

games.name: CrimSaw
games.desc: RIP. THEIR. HEADS. OFF. CrimSaw is a small, fast-paced, and deadly arena FPS with a ‘spin’. You can’t jump and only armed with a badass weapon. Charge, launch and recall your sawblade to slice up endless hordes of demons into pieces. Survive as long as you can and climb up the global leaderboard!

games.name: Weeb Store Simulator
games.desc: Become the ultimate otaku store manager in Weeb Store Simulator! Sell games, consoles, manga, and more with friends in co-op multiplayer. Start small, unlock licenses, and grow your otaku paradise. Let’s build the ultimate anime haven together!

games.name: Time of Dragons
games.desc: Это MMO-шутер, в котором вы сражаетесь на драконах, вооруженных ракетами и лазерами!

games.name: The Settlers Online
games.desc: Постройте свое средневековое королевство прямо сейчас в The Settlers Онлайн!

games.name: Medusa's Labyrinth
games.desc: Medusa’s Labyrinth is a very short mythological first-person horror game set in ancient Greece. It takes myths and legends that have stayed with us for over 2000 years and mix them together with modern gameplay. The game let's you explore murky catacombs and follow along a classic, tragic story.

games.name: Alarm112: Fire Unit
games.desc: Руководите пожарно-спасательными операциями под давлением времени. Принимайте экстренные вызовы, отправляйте подразделения и принимайте важные решения в реалистичном стратегическом симуляторе экстренных служб.

games.name: Black Squad
games.desc: Black Squad is a free-to-play military first-person-shooter. Players can master their skills and show off their strategies with a wide range of game maps, modes, and weapons to choose from. Join thousands of FPS players worldwide in one of the most played games on Steam!

games.name: My Singing Monsters
games.desc: Создайте остров, полный поющих монстров, а затем посмотрите, как ваша песня развивается, когда вы разводите и обновляете счастливых животных-монстров. Создавайте и создавайте уникальные украшения, чтобы ваш мир выглядел так, как вы хотите, а затем делитесь своим творением с друзьями!

games.name: Ocelot Sunrise
games.desc: Die...and then die again in Ocelot Sunrise, the action roguelite with a dark and atmospheric comic art style and extra-galactic weapon combinations! Help is on the way, but can you survive?

games.name: The Great Below
games.desc: Immerse yourself in a haunting map-based horror experience, reminiscent of the iconic PS1 era. Navigate between 2D and 3D perspectives to break free from the loop in a mysterious mansion. Solve challenging puzzles to unveil the secrets hidden beneath it all.

games.name: Villagers and Heroes
games.desc: Лучшая 3D MMO-игра! Фэнтезийная RPG со сражениями, лошадьми, ремеслами и домами!

games.name: 虎馬 / Trauma
games.desc: "Trauma" is a walking simulator action-adventure game sprinkled with horror elements. The only action you can perform besides walking is stabbing with a knife. Enjoy your journey into the strange world of dreams.

games.name: Creepy Camping
games.desc: Инди-хоррор. Главный герой приезжает в лес на автодоме. Лес окутан тайнами и загадками. Исследуя лес, со временем кемпинг превращается в настоящий кошмар. Герой понимает, что он не один в лесу...

games.name: Cataegis : The White Wind
games.desc: Welcome to Cataegis - The White Wind: Ziggurat Chapter, a frantic 2D arcade action retro-style game that pays homage to the glory days of 8-bit side scrolling gaming.

games.name: MachineCraft
games.desc: The main purpose of this game is showing and watching machines made out of blocks. Some of the game-modes allow you to battle or race against other players. (testing phase) You can create your original machine with ease by reassembling those machines that are distributed, or by using the automatic control block.

games.name: Jezebel
games.desc: Jezebel is a narrative-driven visual novel set in medieval Rosegate. Play as Duvessa Devereux, a ruthless noblewoman scheming her way to power. With RPG elements and branching paths, your choices shape her fate and the future of the kingdom.

games.name: Они ушли в спешке: игра в поиск предметов
games.desc: Исследуйте дом, покинутый в спешке, и находите скрытые предметы среди забытых вещей. Возвращайте порядок комнате за комнатой — без таймеров и давления.

games.name: Multishop Tycoon Deluxe
games.desc: A simplified business model of food selling shop network. Do your best to become the great businessman in the city. Enjoy the game!

games.name: The Protagonist: EX-1
games.desc: You’re a highly trained soldier on a mission to infiltrate an alien space station that goes horribly wrong—find your team and discover the hidden truth. Upgrade, Craft, and Discover technologies, Enhance your character’s skills in this gripping turn-based tactical RPG.

games.name: Dungeon of Rikka
games.desc: Dungeon of Rikka is a turn based Rogue-like game with the goal to save your village from the impending doom of the beast that's been sealed away to rot in the deepest corner of the Dungeon. The beast will break his shackles and ascend the Dungeon, becoming stronger the longer you take to get to him.

games.name: Leaf Blower Revolution - Idle Game
games.desc: Blow leaves, upgrade your gear, and automate your progress as you explore the Leaf Universe. A satisfying incremental idle game where every leaf blown brings you closer to the next big upgrade. Simple, relaxing, and endlessly rewarding. Let the leaves fall, and your progress rise!

games.name: ROUGH KUTS: Night of the Living Dead
games.desc: Interactive Film: NIGHT OF THE LIVING DEAD

games.name: Empires Mod
games.desc: Unique strategy/first person shooter mix: One commander on each team plays from above, choosing research, placing buildings and giving orders. The rest fill the role of soldiers on the ground, with four distinct classes to choose from and customizable vehicles to drive.

games.name: 谎月香格里拉
games.desc: A sad tale of lies and understanding. Even if it's your lie, I'm willing to accept it. As a romance visual novel game, this work uses the labels 'lie', 'moon' and 'tale of woe' throughout the main story. The love story between the heroine and the charming but sinful heroes is depicted.

games.name: Where Is Sarah?
games.desc: You shall look for Sarah that faded out of your whole memory. The circumstance and unknown guy who often interrupts you would bother you continuously. Chronic drinking and overtime works had destructed your mind, but you will get back your memories and your wife, Sarah, too.

games.name: Vom Drachentöten
games.desc: Ein klassisches Rollenspiel, reduziert auf den Zauber des alten Genres: Wortgewaltige Sprache. Fordernde Kämpfe. Drei, die einen Drachen töten – und was sie dazu führen mag. [German language only]

games.name: Water Festa
games.desc: Water Festa is a top-down shooter inspired by Thailand's Songkran water festival. You play as a mermaid girl, balancing wetness to remain human, dodge water to avoid becoming too wet, but seek it when dry. Expect a casual bullet hell experience as people continuously shower you.

games.name: Anno Online
games.desc: Anno Онлайн – это бесплатная градостроительная игра, которая позволяет заниматься развитием великолепных крупных городов в средневековом антураже.

games.name: Frozen Free Fall: Snowball Fight
games.desc: «Холодное сердце: Звездопад. Снежки» – увлекательная игра-головоломка с 375 уровнями, локальным многопользовательским режимом и потрясающе красивой графикой.

games.name: Hyperdrive Massacre
games.desc: Hyperdrive Massacre is an 80s inspired arcade fragfest in Spacewar sauce designed around local multiplayer, focused on kinestetics, tactical and shooting skills at a frenzied pace.

games.name: Uriel's Chasm 2: את
games.desc: את is an allegorical, multi-genre Love story and exploration of the Biblical themes of paradise and sacrifice vs offering.

games.name: NEKOPALIVE
games.desc: The catgirls of La Soleil takes to the stage and steps into the spotlight with their very own live concert. Dancing, singing, MIX'ing and purring, this is the NEKOPARA event that comes right home to you, and you got the best seat in the house! No idol can compare to a catgirl, nyaaa~

games.name: Argo
games.desc: Окунитесь в головокружительные сражения в этой официальной, самостоятельной и БЕСПЛАТНОЙ версии Arma 3. Argo представляет собой хардкорный тактический шутер от первого лица, в котором вы сражаетесь с противниками на неограниченной местности, где каждый выстрел на вес золота.

games.name: Flame of Memory
games.desc: Flame of Memory is a strategy/indie game where your task is to survive as long as you can, in a dark forest. At your disposal will get two guerillas, whom you can give commands. How long can you survive?

games.name: idleBeer
games.desc: Welcome to idleBeer, it have beers and steam trading cards!

games.name: Operation: Harsh Doorstop
games.desc: Operation: Harsh Doorstop is the ultimate, free to play, tactical shooter sandbox. Play singleplayer, multiplayer, or co-op modes and explore thousands of community-created maps, weapons, and vehicles via the Steam Workshop. Created by developers of the cancelled Project Reality 2 project.

games.name: Sherwood Extreme
games.desc: Совместный шутер из арбалета и паркура! Проходите уровни или сражайтесь с полчищами врагов, сочетая замедленную снайперскую стрельбу и разрушительные действия, чтобы подняться по служебной лестнице. Создавайте карты в редакторе уровней.

games.name: Hypno-Mart
games.desc: A short visual novel about a stylish blonde-dyed part-timer who works the night shift.

games.name: Trenches VR
games.desc: Trenches VR is a psychological horror game where your microphone becomes part of the terror - enemies can hear your real-life breathing, whispers, or cries for help. Stay quiet, stay hidden… or they’ll come for you.

games.name: CEO Sim: Cyberpunk
games.desc: Станьте CEO корпорации в мире киберпанка. В этой пошаговой стратегии вам предстоит управлять компанией в условиях кризиса, корпоративных войн и давления совета директоров. Принимайте решения, от которых зависит будущее корпорации.

games.name: Wacky Burgers
games.desc: Wacky Burgers - это казуальная, милая игра в жанре point-and-click. Вы играете роль владельца бургерной, к которому приходит множество странных покупателей, и вы должны развивать свой магазин, продавая им еду.

games.name: Commando Jack
games.desc: A Tower Defence game, that actually allows you to sit inside the turret and come face-to-face with the enemies! Addictive strategy - action game, with loads of shooting and explosions! Nearing 2 MILLION DOWNLOADS!

games.name: M.A.R.S.
games.desc: MARS is a Free-To-Play Third Person Shooter set in an evolving sci-fi world. From the hilarious Headhunter mode, to Huge Mecha vs Mecha battles, to fully customizable loadouts; whether Co-op or PvP, M.A.R.S. has something for everyone. Kill, Die, Repeat.

games.name: Moorhuhn Winter Edition
games.desc: Готовьтесь к Moorhuhn Winter Edition! Цельтесь, стреляйте и набирайте очки в быстрых 90‑секундных раундах на заснеженной карте, полной секретов. Открывайте бонусные цели, запускайте цепные реакции и избегайте ловушек вроде самолетов и дирижаблей.

games.name: Seduce Me the Otome
games.desc: A romantic comedy visual novel centered around a girl named Mika Anderson, who gets entangled in the affairs of incubi.

games.name: Arcane Sorcery
games.desc: Arcane Sorcery is a 4x strategy game. You are a sorcerer king. Cast powerful spells from afar from one of 4 spell books. Train units and build your economy. High strategy on a campaign map as well in turn base battles. Challenging AI that does not get buffs in all but the hardest difficulty.

games.name: Mansions of Madness
games.desc: A companion app for the Mansions of Madness Second Edition board game from Fantasy Flight Games. Mansions of Madness is a cooperative game of mystery and investigation inspired by the writings of H. P. Lovecraft. During each game, one to five players explore a location to unravel a mystery.

games.name: Cabals: Card Blitz
games.desc: Build decks and fight auto-battles.

games.name: Beyond Enemy Lines: Operation Arctic Hawk
games.desc: Навигация, наблюдение, проникновение. Освободите заложника у торговца оружием, адаптируйтесь к погодным условиям, используйте ночные укрытия. Выбирайте свой стиль - палящее оружие или бесшумный убийца. Ваш выбор, ваше мастерство, ваша игра.

games.name: Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis
games.desc: ММО-боевик Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis. Станьте воинами ARKS Defenders, исследуйте планету Halpha и победите в эпических сражениях! Дайте волю фантазии в редакторе персонажа и воплотите мечты.

games.name: Monsters sandbox
games.desc: Многопользовательская игра с возможностью подключения по LAN или Internet. Боритесь против монстров в одиночку или совместно с друзьями. Находите оружие и патроны во время игры или купите их в магазине. Разные режимы игры.

games.name: A Winding Path
games.desc: A Winding Path is a hand-drawn adventure game about finding the beauty of the world and enjoying the little things. Explore the atmosphere of ancient caverns, enchanting forests and busy settlements, help colorful characters, find the rain and unveil its magic. The Rainmaker awaits!

games.name: GyroBlade
games.desc: Retro style 2D vertical scrolling simple shooter.

games.name: BeachHead Rogue
games.desc: BH Rogue is the next exciting iteration of the BeachHead brand. It blends the action FPS of the original BeachHead game with new Rogue-lite elements. Join the BeachHead defenders against the Musso Khan forces!

games.name: Death Unphased
games.desc: Invent your own path! Phase through walls with your dash and blaze towards the exit. Death Unphased is a short experience fusing precision and puzzle platforming. Speedrun the smartest routes and aim to beat your fastest time in each level.

games.name: TaskPals
games.desc: TaskPals is a simple companion app that brings life to your taskbar with cute and tiny pals.

games.name: KAMI 2
games.desc: Kami 2 — расслабляющая головоломка, где нужно складывать цветную бумагу, чтобы заполнить поле одним цветом. Проходите уровни или создавайте свои. Сделано с настоящей бумагой.

games.name: Florensia
games.desc: Florensia is a Free-to-Play MMORPG and shows you its legendary worlds ashore and at sea with its 3D anime style. Mysterious islands, the great ocean, dungeons, picturesque pirates and dangerous monsters are waiting to be discovered.

games.name: Corroded
games.desc: Corroded is the ultimate free-for-all online arena brawler where up to six players fight and knock each other out of a shrinking arena. Set in a distant future, take control of a battle-robot and enter the arena for an intense experience.

games.name: NVIDIA® VR Funhouse
games.desc: Step right up to VR Funhouse and enter a virtual carnival full of fun and games. Be an archer with flaming arrows. Test your skill shooting skeet targets blasted from a cannon. See how many moles you can punch, whack, and much more.

games.name: Picross Touch
games.desc: Find the hidden image in this fun and addictive logic puzzle game. All puzzles have unique solutions, ensuring 100% logically solvable puzzle grids.

games.name: The Challenge
games.desc: Рассвет эпохи путешествий во времени пришелся на начало 22 века. Тогда же по решению Совета Безопасности ООН было создано «Бюро времени» - специальная служба надзора, сотрудники которой обязаны устранять анахронизмы.

games.name: Roomscale Tower
games.desc: Roomscale Tower is a photogrammetric experience built for the HTC Vive. Become a knight of the Middle Ages and leave in search of wealth through towers filled with traps. Fight skeleton's army in intense survival mode. Climb mountains, catch piglets, throw knifes or relax at the tavern.

games.name: Let's Draw
games.desc: Let's Draw is a drawing game for everyone especially children ...

games.name: Doodle God Blitz
games.desc: Способность творить теперь полностью в твоих руках! В этой захватывающей игре для всех возрастов в твоем распоряжении окажутся огонь, земля, вода и воздух - комбинируй их и получай новые элементы, чтобы построить целую цивилизацию!

games.name: Freefall 3050AD
games.desc: Tony Takoushi Presents... Freefall 3050AD - The first game where you can move,spin, shoot and airbrake while taking out the bad guys! '... There really isn’t anything quite like it out there in the wide world of video games that I have ever played.'

games.name: Coloring Game
games.desc: Coloring Game – яркий представитель анти-стрессовых игр. Оживите пиксельную картинку, раскрасив её полностью.

games.name: America's Army 3
games.desc: Download AA3 Today and Become a Member of the elite America's Army Team! America's Army fans and new players alike can now experience America's Army 3, the official U.S. Army game.

games.name: EverQuest II
games.desc: EverQuest® II is a deep fantasy MMORPG with over two decades of content, a thriving world, and ongoing expansions that keep Norrath growing. Create your hero and adventure through a massively rich, ever-evolving universe.

games.name: Ragnarok Online
games.desc: In the world of Rune Midgard, it was a time of strife between the Gods, Humans and demons...Battle weary from the long war's carnage, the factions entered into an uneasy truce. The truce grew into a fragile peace that lasted for a thousand years.

games.name: Kill The Cute
games.desc: Безжалостно уничтожай милых! Выбирай своего бойца, собирай души и создавай разрушительные билды умений. Прокачивайся, приспосабливайся и высвобождай чистый хаос в этом динамичном 2D-экшене!

games.name: I AM RABBIT
games.desc: 3D Flatformer Cute Adventure Rabbit Game Traverse captivating landscapes from forests to cities, seas, skies, and even the moon itself ! Enjoy charming low-polygon graphics ! Overcome challenging traps !

games.name: Dragon's Prophet
games.desc: From the creators of Runes of Magic, Dragon's Prophet is a free to play fantasy MMO that transports you to the breathtaking world of Auratia, a realm where dragons fill the sky. For thousands of years, the epic wars between ancient dragons have threatened to plunge Auratia into chaos.

games.name: My Liege
games.desc: As lord of the smallest noble house sworn to your Liege, you must lead your people and family through turmoil. In this choose your own adventure RPG, can you grow your influence while keeping neighbors from taking over thy lands? Pick everything from house name, sigil, and commands for your house!

games.name: Clicker Kingdom
games.desc: Кликай по золоту. Строй королевство. Стань непристойно богатым. Уютный средневековый idle-кликер с 8 гильдиями, 20 зданиями и 315 улучшениями. Вознесение. Престиж. Повтор. Даже твой Twitch-чат может войти в королевство. 50 достижений ждут, Ваше Величество.

games.name: The Tall Man Tapes
games.desc: The Tall Man Tapes is a found footage inspired horror game. You're a UFO investigator trying to get to the bottom of a mystery. Will you learn the truth and escape with your life?

games.name: The Dark Stone from Mebara
games.desc: Set in 1924 Massachusetts, take the role of Detective Monroe, Professor Webley, and Boss Pendleton of the Pendleton Agency, all of whom have come to possess an eerie black rock with strange properties.

games.name: 404Sight
games.desc: 404Sight is a free game made in support of net neutrality. It’s a 3D playground runner influenced by parkour running with the addition of a special ping ability that reveals areas that can speed the player up or slow them down.

games.name: Bombardiro Crocodilo: The Naked Clue
games.desc: Визуальная новелла в жанре "нуарный рассказ", где суровость "Города Грехов" объединяется с юмором «Голого пистолета», безумием «Арчера» и итальянским брейнротом!

games.name: Ariokan™ - create your cards, break the Meta
games.desc: Ariokan™ is a highly interactive, strategically-deep competitive card game with a twist: you can create new cards, and use them to build crazy combos around Gods and Legends to break the Meta. No floodgates, no 10-minutes turns, no pay-to-win. You can unlock cards created by other players too!

games.name: StarBreak
games.desc: StarBreak is a unique skill-based action platformer MMO where you explore strange sci-fi worlds alongside dozens of other players, kill legions of dangerous aliens and fight epic boss battles.

games.name: Teddy Collector
games.desc: Not just luck, a skill-based claw machine with real physics, arcade minigames, and dozens of teddies to collect.

games.name: LuckCatchers
games.desc: "LuckCatchers" – массовая многопользовательская онлайн игра в мире магии и пара. Стань пиратом, торговцем, перевозчиком или производителем в этом недружелюбном мире, населенном драконами.

games.name: The Battle Of Mahjong
games.desc: You can only find out the fun of playing “Mahjong” by yourself, I'm sure you'll addicted to it. Don’t hesitate, come and join “ THE BATTLE OF MAHJONG”!

games.name: The Pillage
games.desc: A fast paced hack-n-slash arcade game where kidneys are harvested from everyone in your path.

games.name: The Hospital: Allison's Diary
games.desc: "The Hospital: Allison's Diary" is a new horror virtual reality experience, putting the user alone in an abandoned hospital searching for the unknown with only the help of a single torch. You will face true fear in a way you had never thought possible.

games.name: Bloodbound: Vampire Hunters
games.desc: Bloodbound is a Vampire, Vampire Slayer multiplayer first-person action shooter. Locations are varied and detailed, and each character comes with its own unique weapons and special abilities. Pick a side, squad up, and master a rising roster of fearless characters in this fast-paced bloody FPS.

games.name: The Backrooms Game FREE Edition
games.desc: Nothing but the stink of old, moist carpets, the madness of mono-yellow, and the blinding light of fluorescent bulbs at maximum hum-buzz. Over 600 million sq. miles of randomly segmented rooms. God save you if you hear something wandering nearby, because it sure as hell has heard you.

games.name: Mines of Volantis
games.desc: Dig for rare minerals, upgrade your harvester and unlock research to escape from planet Volantis.

games.name: Elite Soldier: 3D Shooter
games.desc: Там, где не справляется целый спецназ — справится один штурмовик и винтовка.

games.name: Temple of Apshai Trilogy
games.desc: In this classic dungeon crawler, hack and slash your way through over 500 rooms with dozens of terrifying monsters. A true 1980s fantasy game, experience the frustrations and triumphs of the tabletop gaming inspired combat. Temple of Apshai is waiting. Silently lurking. Patiently waiting. For you.

games.name: Shadow of Azrael
games.desc: Fighting that's a cross between Smash Bros and Dragon Ball Z!

games.name: 道不可道
games.desc: This is a rougelike game that continues to explore, develop, and fight automatically in the form of choosing one from three.

games.name: EEP 17 Eisenbahn.exe Professional - Aufbau- und Steuerungssimulation
games.desc: Imagine and build an extreme realistic railway network, then regulate the rail, the road but also the air and water traffic thanks to a sophisticated signaling system.

games.name: страшная жена качестве HD
games.desc: You wake up in your house but there is a girl here. She said she is your new wife and you are the husband. But you don't have a memories about your marriage with her. Is it some kind of prank? Something is very creepy about her, say hello to your new scary wife!

games.name: The Drain
games.desc: Feed your master before sunrise. Noise gets you killed. Upgrades cost your life. Death means new body parts to try out. And what do you do during the day...? Well, that's another story. The Drain is a hand-drawn action roguelite inspired by campy '80s and '90s horror, with a sparkle of sunshine.

games.name: Двуединое сознание: Враг из ниоткуда Коллекционное Издание
games.desc: Никогда еще наука не была так опасна! Смерть витает в воздухе... Звучит довольно зловеще, не так ли? Помогите детективам раскрыть новое дело!

games.name: CABAL Online
games.desc: The original revolution of action has arrived on Steam. Put your skills to the test in one of the most renowned action-oriented and diverse MMORPG experiences of all time. Play now for free!

games.name: DarkEnd
games.desc: Conquer the ever changing dungeons of DarkEnd and save the fall of humanity! Choose your heroes and venture into a world filled with numerous treasures, mysterious secrets and discover a haunting past in this 10+ hours of retro 2D Dungeon-Crawling!

games.name: Sunrider: Mask of Arcadius
games.desc: As Captain Kayto Shields, embark on a galactic voyage of heroism and survival. With his home world destroyed and his nation conquered, the inexperienced Captain Shields, and his newly minted vessel, the Sunrider, are left as the only hope against a galactic evil intent on subjugating all sentient life.

games.name: Bloop Reloaded
games.desc: Your favourite chemistry potions puzzler is back in Bloop Reloaded and ready to test the brain cells like never before. Make sure you save as much of the potions as possible. How you do it is up to you!

games.name: ふとんがふっとんだ！with ロケットランチャー
games.desc: Blow away the futon with a rocket launcher! Fly it far, you win.

games.name: Passing Pineview Forest
games.desc: Passing Pineview Forest is a free mini-prequel set in the universe of Pineview Drive. Behind the abandoned house on Pineview Drive lies ominous Pineview Forest...

games.name: Dragon Saga
games.desc: Dragon Saga is a f2p arcade style side scrolling 3D Fantasy MMORPG set in a world of Dragons and magic. Choose one of four classes (Warrior, Mage, Thief, and Archer) and explore a rich world filled with unique monsters. Power up to unlock devastating abilities, hidden combos and hilarious effects.

games.name: The Useless Wizard
games.desc: Алкоголик-волшебник без заклинаний, только с камнями, должен спасти свою деревню от развратных орд монстров. Тактический экшен, хаотичные комбинации оружия и тёмный юмор сталкиваются в этом уникальном повороте формулы Vampire Survivors!

games.name: Bell Ringer
games.desc: Bell Ringer is a fast paced arena PvP brawler with local and online multiplayer. Gather your friends and brace yourselves for some intense brawling! Choose between five unique characters with different weapons, special moves and styles.

games.name: One Troll Army
games.desc: Play as a giant troll in One Troll Army - a defense game about building forts, upgrading your troll, and fighting off waves of enemies. Play Against The Twitch Chat!

games.name: とぼとぼリカバリー
games.desc: "Why did it come to this?" That's what the protagonist asks, his body and mind worn to the breaking point. From there begins a journey of rediscovering the self he had long neglected. A small action at a time, he plods forward — slowly, haltingly — toward recovery.

games.name: Idling to Rule the Gods
games.desc: Idling to Rule the Gods is a free to play Idle-Game with a lot of content and some Minigames. Depending on your play-style, you can play it fast or slow. Either way it can be fun for hundreds of hours!

games.name: Evolvation
games.desc: Evolvation - это случайный многопользовательский и динамичный космический летающий шутер, разработанный армией из двух человек из Амстердама. Классы: Highspeed, Fighter, Stealth, Support и Tank. Каждый класс имеет свою особую способность, которая обеспечивает динамичный игровой процесс.

games.name: SHINORUBI
games.desc: Вдохновленная классическими японскими шутерами, SHINORUBI является чистой дозой адреналина и бешеного аркадного экшена со всеми лучшими аспектами японских игр 'bullet hell', оптимизированная для современных ПК в ультра HD, и все это в отполированном, доступном виде с множеством уровней сложности.

games.name: Disaster
games.desc: Disaster - Вам предстоит взять на себя роль грабителя банков в обычном городе. Этот день не предвещал беды, но случилось ужасное событие.

games.name: Bitter Belief
games.desc: Bitter Belief is a small metroidvania game that with a very engaging story provides adventure and drama. Face monsters and challenges as you travel through unknown lands in search of the magic eyes of stone to bring your exorcist father back to life, after having a contact with his spirit.

games.name: Chinese Characters
games.desc: "Chinese characters" is an elimination and puzzle game, put the same three words into the bottom slot to eliminate, eliminate all the words to pass the level, the game should always pay attention to the lower level of the text.

games.name: Unrelaxing Quacks
games.desc: Survivors but fast. Ditch the waiting simulators. Embrace the speedrun. Power up quickly, but expect the challenge to match with dynamically raising difficulty. There is no meta progression to save you, only option is to learn the map and get good at the game.

games.name: Rugby League Team Manager 4
games.desc: The fourth instalment of “The Number 1 Rugby League Management Game”. The biggest leagues and competitions. Take full control of managing your own Rugby League club. Training schedules, coaches, physios, scouting, finances, sponsors and more. MUCH MORE!

games.name: RELOADIAN
games.desc: Reloadian — это экшен-рогалик с упором на стремительные сражения. Комбинируйте легендарное оружие и восстановите порядок в хаотичной вселенной—в одиночку или с друзьями.

games.name: Gigantic
games.desc: Gigantic – стратегический командный шутер, в котором персонажи сражаются бок о бок с громадными стражами. Лишь смелые и находчивые станут Гигантами!

games.name: Dev Guy
games.desc: With your final build missing, and only till the end of the night to publish his game, Warren must take up the difficult adventure to make a new build before the end of the night through whatever means necessary. Join Warren's quest to publish his title before the end of the night and become an indie dev.

games.name: Yandere Maid~Love-Crazed Maid~
games.desc: Вы и горничная начинаете совместную жизнь. Однако по мере развития сюжета горничная становится все более и более «яндере». Сможете ли вы сбежать от горничной-яндере и узнать правду о ней? Это немного страшная игра про симпатичную горничную.

games.name: Falcon
games.desc: When you climb into the cockpit of the F-16 Fighting Falcon, get set for the "flight of your life" as the powerful FALCON F-16 takes you streaking across the sky at Mach 2.

games.name: 플라워던전
games.desc: Choose a beautiful hero and grow stronger as you battle through unpredictable dungeons in this pixel art roguelite adventure RPG! Begin your journey into a dungeon filled with hundreds of events, enemies, and hidden secrets...!

games.name: Ace Of Words

games.name: AltspaceVR
games.desc: AltspaceVR is the leading platform for live, virtual events, empowering artists, brands, and businesses to easily design meaningful experiences that foster community and connection.

games.name: Tactical Craft Online
games.desc: Tactical Craft Online - ММО песочница с элементами тактической ролевой игры с большим открытым разрушаемым миром, кланами, торговлей между игроками, строительством, разнообразным крафтом, добычей руды, фермерством, рыбалкой и т.д.

games.name: Spellstone
games.desc: Spellstone is a fantasy card game with beautiful hand-drawn art and rich lore! Collect hundreds of striking cards to battle through a compelling story and unravel the mystery of the Void.

games.name: Black Rose
games.desc: Equipped with a flashlight, investigate an abandoned funeral home that's said to be haunted. Find out what really happened to the people who once worked there, and hope that this dark, eerie building doesn't become your final resting place.

games.name: Driver Booster 5 for Steam
games.desc: Driver Booster 5 for Steam, with its new interactive interface and greatly expanded database which can support more than 1,000,000 drivers and game components, is an easy-to-use yet powerful driver updater. Put simply, it increases your system compatibility & stability.

games.name: Dead Link: Pages Torn

games.name: missed messages.

games.name: iVRy Driver for SteamVR
games.desc: Use your iPhone, Android, GearVR, Oculus, Vive Wave, Pico Mobile or Sony Playstation VR/VR2 headset as a Virtual Reality Headset for your PC. Lets you run SteamVR & Oculus Rift PC VR titles without a dedicated PC VR headset.

games.name: Wardwell House
games.desc: A storm washed you upon the shore of a mysterious island with a horrific past. A terrifying first-person atmospheric horror game.

games.name: Maniac Path 2
games.desc: Maniac Path 2 - эта продолжение безбашеной игры про маньяка, в который приходится много убивать своих жертв.

games.name: Critical Damage
games.desc: "Critical Damage"-аркадный экшен, где мы управляем боевым роботом, уничтожая пришельцев на космической станции "Зенит-3".

games.name: CRIXUS: Life of free Gladiator
games.desc: Симулятор от первого лица, игра-менеджер Людуса в Древнем Риме. Управляйте гладиаторами, заботьтесь об их нуждах, выращивайте пищу, лечите и тренируйте их. Сражайтесь сами в арене. Побеждайте в турнирах и станьте самым известным владельцем Людуса!

games.name: Legacy
games.desc: Legacy is open world of exploration, survival, crafting and city building. Start as a primitive and naked man or woman and build your character and tribe. You will pass traits on to your offspring and losing a tribe member in battle can have serious consequences. Your decisions will be your legacy.

games.name: Limsod
games.desc: Limsod — это шутер от первого лица, действие которого разворачивается в постапокалиптическом мире, где вам предстоит сражаться за выживание в окружении плотоядных зомби. Улучшайте свое снаряжение и играйте на различных картах и в разных режимах.

games.name: Heroine's Quest: The Herald of Ragnarok
games.desc: Героиня должна выстоять против сил мороза и положить конец долгой зиме. Её мощь, магия и хитрость могут стать последней надеждой человечества. Heroine's Quest - гибрид Adventure/RPG в ретро-стиле, передающий атмосферу и дух классических игр.

games.name: CBO TD
games.desc: CBO TD is a build your own maze tower defense. Protect your castle from hordes of mobs with different classes of towers.

games.name: Falcon A.T.
games.desc: When you climb into the cockpit of the F-16 Fighting Falcon, get set for the "flight of your life" as the powerful FALCON AT takes you streaking across the sky at Mach 2.

games.name: Guns and Robots

games.name: Eldevin

games.name: The Living Shadows

games.name: Hounimal

games.name: Taram Baba

games.name: Party Jousting
games.desc: A one-button party game for 2-16 players, sharing a keyboard or controller.

games.name: Zombie Wasteland Together
games.desc: Zombie Wasteland Together — это кооперативный зомби-шутер для 1–4 игроков, действие которого разворачивается в постапокалиптической пустыне. Объединяйтесь с друзьями, сражайтесь с бесконечными ордами зараженных и выживайте, используя мощное оружие.

games.name: Gebub's Adventure

games.name: DEATH TRAIN - Warning: Unsafe VR Experience

games.name: Cyberia 2: Resurrection

games.name: RAILED
