Lay railways and build tracks to connect stations and gold mines while accomplishing random challenges. Navigate mountains, bonus tiles, and your own creations to dominate a global leaderboard.

games.name: Cosmic collapse
games.desc: Лазеры, бластеры, чёрные дыры и огромное множество врагов... Всё это находится в бескрайнем космосе, просторы которого вам предстоит зачистить от недругов!

games.name: Fast Dust
games.desc: Fast Dust – это гонки на автомобилях с характером, сильно обитых, но все еще с большой мощностью под капотом. Вы можете выбирать среди 70-и маршрутов: по лесным дорогам, в песчаном каньоне или же в старом заводском городке. Приготовитесь к дождю, снегу, туману и ночной езде. Откройте короткий путь и выиграйте!

games.name: BLASK
games.desc: BLASK -— это уникальная игра-головоломка, в которой вы управляете окружающей средой, чтобы поразить все маркеры целей лазерами.

games.name: PlayClaw 7 - Game Overlays, Recording and Streaming
games.desc: Use our cool in-game overlays to achieve the best gaming experience! Harnessing the power of your GPU, hardware accelerated H.264 codecs and the various overlays, you will have an advantage over your opponents and you can share your victories.

games.name: The Terrible Old Man
games.desc: Experience a bite-sized slice of Lovecraftian horror in this updated version of our cult freeware point and click adaptation of H.P. Lovecraft's classic short story.

games.name: Путь Маньяка
games.desc: Вам предстоит пройти путь жестокого убийцы, который движимый инстинктом бродит по улицам в поисках жертв.

games.name: PARTY RUSH!!
games.desc: Here we present, a cynical RPG with close to 160,000 patterns of party making. Choose your favorite from about 100 different characters and save the pixelated world. Some events spawn only during certain days of the week. No need to worry, "somebody from another dimension" will help you.

games.name: Nova Antarctica
games.desc: Nova Antarctica — это приключенческая игра на выживание с крафтом, действие которой разворачивается в ледяной Антарктиде. Распоряжайтесь скудными запасами, отправляйтесь вглубь ледяных просторов вместе с загадочными животными и выживайте в прекрасном, но пугающем мире.

games.name: Dwarfs - F2P
games.desc: Dwarfs!? is an addictive, fast paced arcade-like experience, with plenty of difficulty levels and game modes, in the tradition of great games such as “Lemmings” and “Dwarf Fortress”.

games.name: Broken Blade: Prelude
games.desc: Broken Blade: Prelude(프렐류드)는 판타지풍의 시뮬레이션 롤플레잉 게임입니다. 당신은 세계의 운명을 지켜보는 '관찰자'가 되어, 제국의 황녀였던 카모밀레와 그 동료들의 앞을 막아서는 시련을 헤쳐나가기 위해 함께 노력해야 합니다.

games.name: Call of the Abyss
games.desc: Call of the Abyss - карточная rogue-like игра, вдохновленная таким аниме, как Made in Abyss. Вам предстоит пройти долгий путь, спускаясь в бездну. Исследуйте глубины этого мира, побеждайте загадочных врагов и находите необъяснимые вещи.

games.name: Pasha Planet: Reborn
games.desc: Игроки возьмут на себя роль Бобби и будут исследовать мирный и спокойный город, который, на самом деле, скоро столкнется с энергетическим кризисом. Игроки должны решить множество головоломок и найти способ спасти всех жителей, пока не наступила беда!

games.name: ToyMaker
games.desc: A creepy lost-media videogame from the past will haunt your dreams.

games.name: DETECTIVE - The Motel
games.desc: DETECTIVE The Motel - это игра на дедукцию, в которой, чтобы продвигаться вперед, вы должны взять карандаш и лист бумаги и записывать все, что кажется доказательством, чтобы ответить на все возникающие вопросы. Решение дела будет зависеть только от вас.

games.name: Midnight Shift
games.desc: Одна девушка работала на заправке в Висконсине, и во время одной полуночной смены с ней случилось непредвиденное.

games.name: CaesarIA
games.desc: CaesarIA - это ремейк олдскульной экономической стратегии: Caesar III. Управление городом, строительство, дипломатия и военные действия. Мы планируем реализовать все лучшее, что было в оригинальной игре и добавлять новые возможности.

games.name: WonderLang Japanese
games.desc: Изучайте японский язык в рамках захватывающих квестов, интерактивных диалогов и боевых испытаний с интервальными повторениями. Помогите юному герою снять магическое проклятие, овладев японским. Начните свое путешествие к свободному владению японским уже сегодня!

games.name: Videonauts
games.desc: Videonauts is a pixel art adventure game where you must escape from a spooky mansion full of deadly traps and terrors. You and your fellow trapped companions want to escape alive... but how you converse and solve exploration-based puzzles can change everyone's fate!

games.name: Holodrive
games.desc: A fast-paced multiplayer shooter where you customize your robot, zoom around with a jetpack, and battle with various weapons. Master the arenas, surprise your enemies, and enjoy the nonstop action!

games.name: TENGAI
games.desc: Three years after Sengoku Ace. The long-awaited sequel arrives!! Saikyo's side-scrolling shooter. The first installment!

games.name: Apotheon Arena
games.desc: Apotheon Arena is the free online-multiplayer complement to the mythic Greek action RPG, Apotheon. Pit your skills with spear and shield against other players in brutal bronze-age combat. Battle across the statuesque arenas of Olympus, depicted with beautiful black-figure pottery artwork.

games.name: Dark Passenger
games.desc: Dark Passenger is an audio game which starts you off in a morbid scenario of having a panic attack as your character adjusts to the fact that their eyes have been recently removed from their body.

games.name: LOGistICAL: USA - Wisconsin
games.desc: LOGistICAL: USA - Wisconsin is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the state. Over 800 towns to complete including cities like Milwaukee, Madison, Green Bay and many, many more.

games.name: A Raven Monologue
games.desc: A Raven Monologue is a short experimental silent story about a raven that does not know how to croak and his relationship with the people in the town.

games.name: Puzzle Pirates
games.desc: Every activity in Puzzle Pirates is a uniquely fun puzzle: be it sailing, gunning, or hauling treasure, your own puzzling skill determines your success!

games.name: The Wilds of Dacrima: Field Notes from a Poorly Supervised Alchemist and his Unruly Clockwork Companion
games.desc: Uncover the secrets of the forest in this tale of two unlikely friends, with alchemist Edric Tayte and L-P1N. Forage for weird and wonderful ingredients, brew Potions to empower you with potent abilities, and all the while discovering that this adventure isn't quite what it seems..

games.name: Bonfire
games.desc: You’re Scout 817, a member of the not so elite Space Force. You’ve just crashed your spaceship on a strange planet. Your only tools for survival are a fading bonfire, a robot and a limited supply of nourishment cylinders. And what's that sneaking around out there in the dark alien jungle?

games.name: Super Chaos
games.desc: EMBRACE/CONTROL CHAOS! Mutate your build in extreme uniquely weird ways to nuke this petri dish clean from eldritch germs in a frantic top‑down physics arcade where every mechanic is bizarre and emergent! Use strangest powers like warping walls, hexes and annihilation and be an arcane germaphobe!

games.name: From Hell
games.desc: From Hell is a third-person action survival horror. Explore an ancient manor in the late 1960s, fight ghouls and all kinds of monsters from the mythical underworld. Survive, craft items, solve puzzles and unlock secrets in the hunt for secret of your missing old friend.

games.name: Aster Fpv Drone Simulator
games.desc: Aster Fpv is the Fpv Drone simulator including fps mode, play in multiplayer or alone. Sneak between moving construction cranes. Practice chasing cars. Race single or multiplayer between buildings and natural obstacles.

games.name: Puzzle & Chess
games.desc: Puzzle & Chess is a relaxing and minimalist game that mixes puzzle challenges with chess moves. Click on pieces, solve the puzzles with a pleasant and relaxing environment. You don't need to know how to play chess to have fun. No score, no timer and no pressure.

games.name: Sacred Cubes
games.desc: Логическая игра с множеством увлекательных уровней разной сложности.

games.name: Anatomy of Fear
games.desc: ANATOMY OF FEAR; It is a survival, thriller, action and puzzle turn-based, multiplayer horror game that can be played with 1-4 people. Do your duty and escape before the mutated beings kill you as you embark on this adventure to reveal the dark side of the company!

games.name: Vinterget
games.desc: Покорите вершину горы в этом коротком платформере. Используйте топорик, чтобы цепляться за поверхности, ловко проходя уровень за уровнем. Прорвитесь сквозь опасности заснеженной горы Винтергет.

games.name: Thriller Garden
games.desc: Inspired by Vampire Survivor. you need to complete various tasks in the raging waves of monsters. During the mission process, you can choose appropriate enhancement options from 120+ unique non-numerical upgrade options to amplify the character's advantages or cover up the disadvantages.

games.name: Knight's Saga Evil Goblins
games.desc: Knight's Saga: Evil Goblins - захватывающая игра в жанре фэнтези, в мир вторглись злые гоблины, вы вступаете в роль отважного воина, отправившегося в опасное путешествие для их уничтожения. Вас ожидают захватывающие приключения и сражения во имя спасения королевства.

games.name: Space Mergers
games.desc: Space Mergers is a satisfying fast-paced puzzle game that encourages critical thinking. Combine blocks to create combos and gain points, reach the highest score you can! There is over a million different ways to play, enjoy some endless fun.

games.name: PROJECT 13 Perception Test
games.desc: Садитесь в продолжение окончательного теста на восприятие! Обнаруживайте и сообщайте об аномалиях в захватывающих сценах, сидя в Наблюдательном Кресле. Победите в испытании, правильно определив 13 аномалий подряд. Вы готовы?

games.name: Retail Simulator
games.desc: Retail Simulator is a 1-4 Co-op game where you build your dream store from scratch in this immersive retail experience. Design the layout with our custom build mode, stock shelves, order inventory. Customize your store's look to attract customers. Choose your scale, from local shop to mega-store.

games.name: Scrapworks Simulator
games.desc: Начинайте как сборщик металлолома в Scrapworks Simulator и двигайтесь к созданию большого производственного цеха. Исследуйте окружающую среду, чтобы найти детали, спрятанные на земле, на фабриках и в заброшенных районах, и соединяйте собранные детали для создания продуктов в своей мастерской.

games.name: Aberoth
games.desc: Aberoth is a fantasy massively multiplayer online role playing game with charming retro graphics and tons of freedom.

games.name: High On Racing
games.desc: High On Racing is an unique Retro Arcade Style Tactical Racing Game that will warp you into the sky to race against the time.

games.name: UFO Online: Invasion
games.desc: UFO Online - тактическая пошаговая MMORPG в постапокалиптическом мире

games.name: Armored Warfare
games.desc: Armored Warfare — это free-to-play MMO, где вы можете участвовать во взрывных танковых сражениях вместе с миллионами игроков со всего мира в режиме online.

games.name: POPixel
games.desc: Hey, have you ever dreamed of being fired by a cannon as a bullet man? How about jumping on balloons popping them ?? You can do all this with POPixel. The game where you become one, jumping and popping balloons. Oh, and don't forget to collect the coins !!

games.name: Magic Lantern
games.desc: "Волшебный фонарь VR" — это уютная виртуальная комната для всей семьи, в которой вы можете смотреть любимые сказки, играть, рисовать и весело проводить время. Совершите путешествие в волшебный завораживающий мир!

games.name: MINDNIGHT
games.desc: Inspired by the party games Werewolf and The Resistance, MINDNIGHT is a cyberpunk online social deduction game of deceit, accusations and unpredictability. It challenges your ability to lie and detect others that are trying to be deceptive.

games.name: Rampage Ragdoll
games.desc: Rampage Ragdoll is a ragdoll fight funny action game. Game Mode:Single Player Mode and Two Players Mode. Single Player Mode：Control the Player1 Ragdoll vs the AI Ragdoll. Two Players Mode: Player1 Ragdoll vs the Player2 Ragdoll. Control:Support keyboard and xbox controller.

games.name: Star Fetchers
games.desc: Пролог к безумному приключению с гангстерами и конспирологическими теориями

games.name: LineVox
games.desc: LineVox - казуальная игра в стиле киберпанк, подходящая как для одного игрока, так и для нескольких, где тебе предстоит управлять кораблём, избегая препятствий, чтобы выиграть.

games.name: 我的变色龙女友My Chameleon Girlfriend
games.desc: A domineering mischievous girl falls in love with me? School Prima Donna loves me only? absurd, this is just a daydream. In fact, there are hidden secrets about the beautiful girl who loves me ... Do you choose to cosset the mischievous girl or the Prima Donna?

games.name: Dirty Wars: September 11
games.desc: Historical indie videogame about the suburbs of the Cold War in South America.

games.name: New Lands 2 Collector's Edition
games.desc: Выращивай какао, яблоки и сахарный тростник. Производи лучшие сладости в регионе и выиграй конкурс!

games.name: EverQuest
games.desc: Welcome to EverQuest® - the original fantasy MMORPG. Explore huge worlds, fight challenging foes, and grow your character with friends. Discover why players have quested, grouped, and raided in Norrath for more than two decades.

games.name: Panda Roll
games.desc: Meet Pandara and Mulatta, the heroes who are looking forward to find the mighty Sun Bamboo, in order to cure Mulatta's mother. In this adventure you will control both at the same time, so that you can use their friendship and trust go through all the puzzles and difficulties to achieve their goals.

games.name: Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl
games.desc: Смешная многопользовательская игра Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl приносит праздничное настроение с абсурдным оружием. Соревнуйтесь с друзьями, жарьте их огнеметом и шлепайте гигантской рыбой. Погрузитесь в этот веселый хаос прямо сейчас!

games.name: Hertz
games.desc: Launch into a fierce roguelite action in this top-down twin-stick shooter with bombs! In a robotic world, control Lizzy and their team of unlockable beasty bots in a quest for upgrades. But beware, needed resources are guarded by swarms of Steel Sentinels. Survive them to craft synergistic builds.

games.name: Get Off My Lawn!
games.desc: Они пришли с миром, но связались не с тем стариком. Вооруженный мушкетом, 78-летний Murray Mendelson в одиночку начал межзвездную войну. В этой бесконечной скоростной аркадной стрелялке сначала стреляй, а вопросы задавай потом.

games.name: Rhythm Reunion - Indie Dating Sim Visual Novel
games.desc: The band is getting back together! Haven't you heard?! 'Summer Vacation' is reuniting for one last gig! Take part in this artistically diverse visual novel as you explore the new lives of each of the old band members, all whilst you convince each of them to return to the lime light!

games.name: My Lands: Black Gem Hunting
games.desc: My Lands – бесплатная реалтаймовая онлайн-стратегия, построенная на противостоянии светлых и темных сил в фентезийном мире. Основа игры – взаимодействие между игроками, совместное развитие экономики, объединение в кланы и союзы, выработка командной стратегии.

games.name: Falco Tunes
games.desc: Falco Tunes - Весёлая аркада, где вам предстоит собирать ноты, и атаковать ими суровых зверей!

games.name: Color Symphony
games.desc: Color Symphony is a game program utilizing the human recognition ability and visual senses, and various colors are used to play the game by changing colors to disrupt the cognition or to strengthen the cognition. The player can control the enemy, eliminate obstacles or build new roads with different colors.

games.name: Destination Sol
games.desc: Отправьтесь в путешествие на космическом корабле по бесшовному открытому миру, сделанному из космоса, планет и звёзд. Ищите для себя новые корабли, новое оборудование, обретайте союзников - всё для того, чтобы победить враждебную силу!

games.name: Civilization IV®: Warlords
games.desc: Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Warlords - первое дополнение для отмеченной наградами игры, которая мгновенно стала мировым хитом. Оказывая уважение некоторым величайшим военачальникам истории, дополнение доставляет шесть уникальных и интересных сценариев, давая игрокам шанс изменить ход истории с помощью их новой…

games.name: 万兽天工
games.desc: Arrange monsters to mine, cut wood, refine equipment, build, and improve the monsters' strength to adventure through levels.

games.name: All Is Dust
games.desc: All Is Dust is a first-person horror game for PC and Oculus Rift. Experience the terror of a dust storm in the 1930s and unravel the mystery surrounding your decaying farm.

games.name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2026
games.desc: Take control of your franchise in Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 26! Draft, trade, and build your dynasty with smarter AI, new player archetypes, refreshed UI, and full customization options that let you create your perfect basketball universe.

games.name: UNSEEN LAND: INTO THE MIST
games.desc: For centuries, Veridia thrived. Now, an otherworldly invader tears rifts, unleashing maddened beasts. In the chaos, you awaken—once a humble farmer and hunter. Take up the sword, wield your power, and save Veridia.

games.name: Assassin Of Goblin
games.desc: Play as warrior and try to beat green goblin in 9 different levels and find captured skulls in this medieval rpg adventure

games.name: Days Under Custody
games.desc: Days Under Custody is a title made as a classic horror adventure game where a dramatic story, unique puzzles and an enemy stalking you all the time, will test and keep you tense to discover the history behind a lot of inexplicable events.

games.name: 鉄道運行管理シミュレーション
games.desc: Take control of signals, routes, and timing in an authentic Japanese railway dispatch simulator. Experience real block signaling and interlocking in stations modeled after real-world lines — approachable enough for newcomers, deep enough for rail fans.

games.name: Golf Around 2
games.desc: Пришло время поиграть в гольф... 2! Безумный гольф для 16 игроков! Тактически используйте гранаты, оружие и перки, чтобы перемещаться по безумным картам. Повышайте уровень и улучшайте своего персонажа. Играйте на пользовательских картах!

games.name: Corpo Tale
games.desc: You play as Martin, a Senior Test Engineer, working in a Test Department and it is Monday, yes... the dreadful Monday. From the beginning of the game you embark on an epic quest to make sure that things actually start working.PLEASE NOTE THAT THE GAME IS NOT YET AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH!

games.name: Poopy Pooper
games.desc: Poopy Pooper, the premier pooping simulator and a first of a kind FPS (First Pooper Sh*tter)

games.name: Soulreign
games.desc: An indie soul-collector online RPG with inventory based auto-combat in the Backpack Battles lineage. Find and bind legendary souls, arrange their item grid, then watch the team fight. 25+ regions, a roguelite Descent, ranked PvP. Buy once, no pay-to-win. Join now and shape the future of the game!

games.name: DANGEROUS DUELS
games.desc: A local multiplayer game for 2-4 players. Only the fastest guns and the fastest on their feet can win!

games.name: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2017
games.desc: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2017 puts you in the role of head coach of your favorite college basketball team. Every decision can be made by you from staff hiring, recruiting, scouting and all the way to making each substitution to lead your team to tournament glory and becoming a dynasty.

games.name: NearEscape
games.desc: Это приключенческая игра, которая ищет потерянные воспоминания в городе.

games.name: WGT Golf
games.desc: Experience iconic golf courses like Pebble Beach, St Andrews and Wolf Creek in the most realistic free golf game, and connect with millions of players all over the world!

games.name: Planet's Edge
games.desc: Travel between dozens of stars, harvest resources to repair and upgrade your equipment, meet and negotiate with friendly (and hostile) aliens, and do whatever it takes to stay alive and bring Earth back in this groundbreaking sci-fi RPG.

games.name: Minicraft Shooter
games.desc: Minicraft Shooter - Это эпический шутер – тайм киллер с видом сверху, в котором вы противостоите бесконечной толпе зомби, в декорациях киберпанк мегаполиса, современного города и зеленого леса. И все это в кубическом стиле!

games.name: Pretty Girls Panic! PLUS
games.desc: Popular Arcade Game "Pretty Girls Panic!" is back with more power. Expand the area steadily and dodge enemy attacks and avoid capture. There are 40 stages in total. Conquer all stages and Complete the rescue of these Pretty Girls.

games.name: 时空梦魇Ⅰ代号608
games.desc: In the apocalyptic world of steampunk, detective Alice Weir investigates a serial murder case, Unfortunately, he was shot dead by a killer during the investigation, but everything was just beginning.....

games.name: Armored Firestorm
games.desc: Armored Firestorm is an intense top-down shoot'em up action game in a futurist environments. At the controls of your Hovertank, survive against the attack of the machines in the orbital city of the federation.

games.name: Tank Commander: Battlefield
games.desc: Get ready to blow up the tanks, shoot for the enemy tanks and claim victory. Accept your commander missions, firing to kill enemy tanks . You need be a tanks hero to win WW2 Battles.

games.name: The Faction
games.desc: Ruan, a member of a criminal faction, goes to a rival faction's point of operation to obstruct his enemies drug operations.

games.name: Continent of the Ninth Seal
games.desc: The Continent of the Ninth Seal (C9) is an action MMORPG. Players take part in the game as heroes of Glenheim to stand against Nefer, an evil villain trying to open a gate to the Netherworld and swarm the land with his infernal legion.

games.name: Dynasthir
games.desc: В своем последнем дыхании Dynasthir зовет. Вам предоставляется огромный, таинственный мир, приглашающий к методичному исследованию, умелым боям и глубоким моментам изумления. Идите в неизведанное, и, возможно, вы переживете, чтобы рассказать свою историю. Мир умирает, будете ли вы настойчивы?

games.name: Bent Oak Island
games.desc: Bent Oak Island is a 1990's point and click adventure set on a mysterious island! Join twins Archer and Sam as they delve into the secrets of both the island and their own heritage, and maybe save the world!

games.name: SynthwaveZ
games.desc: A fast-paced, wave-based zombie shooter set in an alternate 1980s dystopia. Call in airstrikes, deploy support bots, upgrade wild weapons, and survive the horde—solo or with friends. No grinding. No paid DLC. Just pure, chaotic fun.

games.name: The Backrooms: Unseen Tapes
games.desc: "The Backrooms: Unseen Tapes" is a first-person survival horror game where you navigate a maze-like, ever-changing procedurally generated environment. With stealth, speed, and strategy, evade monsters and conserve limited resources to maintain your sanity and escape this nightmarish dimension.

games.name: Navy Field 2 : Conqueror of the Ocean
games.desc: Navy Field 2 is the follow up to Navy Field, the original pioneer of Massively Multiplayer Strategic Online Naval Warfare. Cooperate with your team to maximize the potential of your vessel as you face off in large-scale naval battles. Challenge yourself to become the ultimate captain!

games.name: Audition Online
games.desc: The popular dance and rhythm game, Audition Online, is available for Steam! Create your avatar and play on 20 different game modes.

games.name: A Game About Cutting A Tree
games.desc: Минималистичная игра о восстановлении заросшего леса или заброшенного города. Рубите деревья, собирайте древесину, продавайте её, улучшайте свой топор и раскрывайте секреты, спрятанные под корнями.

games.name: Super Starship
games.desc: A futuristic sci-fi persistent universe exploration game with one million stars and 18 million planets and moons. Fly your ship to any star and explore its solar system. Claiming stars, planets and moons will make them yours forever - other players will see your discoveries and you will see theirs.

games.name: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe
games.desc: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe takes the classic game of Tic-Tac-Toe and adds a strategic layer to it. Game modes: classic, classic forget, ultimate, ultimate forget, ultimate forget total.

games.name: 工廈 Warehouse
games.desc: 工廈 Warehouse is a short action psychological horror game, developed by a solo developer, set in a decaying Hong Kong industrial building. Armed with a VHS camcorder and a handgun, uncover buried guilt and survive the horrors that lurk in the dark as past sins claw their way into the present.

games.name: Аллоды Онлайн
games.desc: Присоединяйтесь к армии поклонников знаменитой отечественной игры! «Аллоды Онлайн» — это современное продолжение легендарной серии русских игр в жанре фэнтези. Игра покорила сердца миллионов игроков, прославившись на родине и за рубежом.

games.name: The Third
games.desc: Двое восстали. Один всё ещё скрывается в тенях. Исследуйте проклятый храм, раскройте древние тайны и выживите в пугающем и захватывающем путешествии среди забытых богов и тьмы.

games.name: Clown House (Palyaço Evi)
games.desc: Freeware horror game with the mise en scène of an old black&white film and unique horror experience.

games.name: Godot Engine
games.desc: Godot Engine is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine to create 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, so that you can focus on making games without having to reinvent the wheel.

games.name: Lullabies Made of Static
games.desc: Мир исчез, и вы остались один. В тихом послесловии падения человечества вы исследуете руины постапокалиптического мегаполиса, окружённого индустриальными бруталистскими фабриками, собирая забытые кассеты, которые откроют, какими когда-то были человеческие эмоции.

games.name: Цена свободы. Тайна кукловода.
games.desc: «Цена свободы: Тайна кукловода» — это остросюжетное приключение в жанре поиск предметов.

games.name: The Cubicle.
games.desc: The Cubicle is a short VR experience about your regular everyday job in an office, or is it?

games.name: Riding Club Championships
games.desc: Riding Club Championships - игра про верховую езду, основанная на онлайн-соревнованиях по реальным дисциплинам конного спорта. Участвуйте в конкуре, скачках вокруг бочек, скачках между стойками, аджилити и аджилити с прыжками.

games.name: Shot Shot Tactic
games.desc: Shot Shot Tactic is a Realistic FPS Game. There are too many weapons ...

games.name: Dark Hope: A Puzzle Adventure
games.desc: Dark Hope is a puzzle adventure game set in a steampunk world where electricity started and ended its existence with the light bulb. Towering clockwork puzzles and archaic symbols cover the halls. Strange rifts of light span the hallways.

games.name: DinosaurIsland
games.desc: Авантюрная игра существования и избиения, приключенческие острые летальные искания, варить разные пищи, изготовить оружия, искать ресурсы, наслаждаться приключенческим путешествием. Жить и исследовать в темной сфере, всегда сохранять бдительность.

games.name: BattleRush
games.desc: Бесплатный многопользовательский экшен в антураже второй мировой войны, с тотальной разрушаемостью окружения. Наслаждайтесь полной свободой, постройте оборону, создайте свою армию, уничтожте противника.

games.name: Knife Flipping
games.desc: Станьте новым королем ножа, бросающим в нож Перевернутый!

games.name: Book Of Yog Idle RPG 依盖之书
games.desc: The Book of Yog is a 3D idle RPG game presented with a Cel-Shading art style. You can rally heroes, develop the kingdom and explore the secrets of a lost world. Dozens of heroes, hundreds of skills, thousands of loot for you to combine freely. Come to embark on a journey to build the strongest team!

games.name: Lost Patrol
games.desc: "We’re fit, we’re alive, but we’re not back home" In this classic multi-genre DOS game, take command of the seven survivors of a U.S. helicopter crash in Vietnam, desperately trekking across 57 miles of harsh terrain infested with booby traps and enemy soldiers.

games.name: 10mg: Locked In
games.desc: Locked In is a two-player visual novel simulating the breakdown of a marriage during lockdown.

games.name: Your Chronicle
games.desc: "Let's begin your own story." This is a text-based idle RPG game. There are already more than 3,000 unique story actions and it's still growing.

games.name: 村庄-The Village
games.desc: After you graduated from college, you were assigned to a small village as a doctor.It looks like an ordinary village, but there are many strange things in it.A man knocking at the door in the middle of the night may not be asking for a doctor.The person you saw may not be alive.Haunted?

games.name: The Dawning Clocks Of Time - Director's Cut
games.desc: A classic story of love, war and betrayal on an intergalatic scale. A epic turn based RPG with both sandbox and linear story progression. Take up arms with energy and exciting weapons and skills for the battle of the ages, who will decide the fate for all of humanity? Director's Cut version!

games.name: Ilum
games.desc: An open-world game in ancient Babylon with elements of action, exploration and city destruction. Archaeologically accurate buildings such as the Tower of Babel and Hanging Gardens. Voice-acted in Akkadian language in a Biblical and Babylonian mythological background.

games.name: Voxel Farm Island
games.desc: You now have a dream island right away! Take care of the farm, develop business, Expand transportation, and there are more interesting things on the island, such as magical giving tree, fishery and the mine full of treasures... You have a most important task - to solve the mystery on the island!

games.name: Metapilot
games.desc: Ever dreamt of being in the Jetsons, a Top Gun or on an 80s nightdrive with a smooth synthwave soundtrack? Now you can do all at once. In partnership with major airtaxi and aerospace companies, you can now fly the latest airtaxi models before they hit the market around Manhattan AND listen to synth!

games.name: Power Champions
games.desc: Explore the universe and protect Zarion from evil invaders led by the fearsome KillDeath. Join the Champions of Power, the most powerful heroes of the universe, to combat destruction and madness in an epic adventure and action game !

games.name: Unknown Signal
games.desc: Unknown Signal - приключенческая 3D-игра. Вы получили загадочный сигнал и вам предстоит узнать что или кто его послал.

games.name: Requiem: Desiderium Mortis
games.desc: Requiem: Desiderium Mortis is a Free-to-Play MMORPG set in a dark distant world where an event known as the "Thanatos Incident" rendered the world almost unlivable. Create your own biological weapon known as a Temperion and experience the horrors that grip Ethergia.

games.name: Velvet Sundown
games.desc: Velvet Sundown is a social multiplayer role-playing game, taking place on a luxury yacht cruising the waters of a fictitious Caribbean state of Balbonia. Embark on a journey full of conspiracies, trickery and secrets where you can never tell a friend from foe.

games.name: Ritualist
games.desc: Ritualist — динамичный изометрический экшен-рогалик в мире тёмного фэнтези. Сражайтесь с древним злом, выбирайте оружие, осваивайте боевые стили и проводите запретные ритуалы, чтобы запечатать Первородных. Сможете ли вы пройти путь до конца — или бездна поглотит вас?

games.name: Sigils of Elohim
games.desc: Sigils of Elohim is a free mini-game prelude to Croteam’s upcoming first-person puzzler The Talos Principle that challenges players to solve dozens of challenging sigil puzzles under the watchful eye of Elohim.

games.name: LoveBeat
games.desc: LoveBeat is a free-to-play rhythm game. A lot of amazing indie songs will give you both the excitement of playing the game and the delight of listening to your favorite songs at the same time. Let’s join LoveBeat dance party where it’s full of friendly people all over the world!

games.name: TriggerHeart EXELICA ENHANCED
games.desc: "Pull the trigger of your heart once again with new friends!"

games.name: Night Shift at the Gym
games.desc: Ночная смена в спортзале. Каждую ночь одни и те же 3 клиента. Одни и те же разговоры. Одни и те же заказы. Так почему же каждый раз становится страннее? После 4 ночей вы столкнётесь с правдой.

games.name: Emporea: Realms of War and Magic
games.desc: Emporea is an oldschool fantasy strategy game, where cooperation with other players is necessary to achieve victory. Only the best alliance can win! Multiple realms available, with new ones starting every two weeks.

games.name: Rising Storm 2: Vietnam
games.desc: Серия Red Orchestra — во Вьетнаме: матчи на 64 игрока, более 20 карт; морская пехота и Армия США, ВНА, НФОЮВ (ВК); австралийцы и войска ВСРВ; более 50 видов оружия; 4 вертолета; мины, ловушки и туннели. Безжалостность. Историчность. Суровый реализм. Изменение персонажей. И запах напалма по утрам.

games.name: Crown and Council
games.desc: Crown and Council is a casual strategy game with short game sessions.

games.name: McOsu
games.desc: A free open-source circle-clicking rhythm game practice client for osu! beatmaps with Virtual Reality support. McOsu is developed separately from and has no direct affiliation with osu! or ppy Pty Ltd.

games.name: CopperCube 6 Game Engine
games.desc: CopperCube is a full-featured 3D game engine. No programming needed! Create 3D games and apps quickly. Includes terrain editor, low poly modelling tools, 3D models, precreated game AI, effects and more.

games.name: SYNTHETIK: Arena
games.desc: "Synthetik: Арена" - это скоростной шутер в мире будущего, которое не наступит. Окунись в мир ретрофутуризма, освой мощные технологии и пройди многочисленные испытания бога машин Zir. Пусть рефлексы тебя не подведут!

games.name: Shotgun n  Zombies
games.desc: A strange fog rise up. You grabbed your shotgun when you heard a voice outside. Wtf Zombies. Try to stay alive for 5 minutes and kill them all to win and unlock next difficulty level.

games.name: The Zone
games.desc: Dimitri has a mission: go to an island and disable all the electrical installations to avoid that strange creatures have multiplies and go out.

games.name: Animaze by FaceRig
games.desc: Приложение Animaze представляет новый взгляд на создание аватара с улучшенным отслеживанием лица, выразительной анимацией, усовершенствованной графикой и множеством новых функций, аватаров и объектов.

games.name: Missing Time
games.desc: An inheritance uproots you back to your hometown. Surrounded by mysteries and temptations, which path will you choose? A horror dating visual novel by Fluttering Abyss.

games.name: MT Force Aliens Uprising
games.desc: Dive into the heart-pounding action as MT Force, an elite government unit racing against time to unravel the mysteries of enigmatic anomalies. Rumors suggest that a mysterious scientist made contact with aliens, and now everything is out of control!

games.name: When I reincarnate, I'm a cube!?
games.desc: The world you've been reincarnated into is a cube!? This is a quest-style light FPS.

games.name: Pasta Master
games.desc: Pasta Master is an adventure 2D platformer set in a world where pasta based food is the most popular type of dish. The game follows Jimmy, a man who gets his pasta stolen by a mysterious figure and sets of on an adventure to get it back…

games.name: Chair Spinning Simulator
games.desc: Chair Spinning Simulator is a short quirky game where you have to spin a chair as fast as possible to reach space in under 60 seconds!

games.name: Страшный Муж HD: аниме хоррор игра
games.desc: You wake up in your house but there is a man here. He said he is your new husband and you are the wife. But you don't have a memories about your marriage with him. Something is very creepy about him, say hello to your new scary husband!

games.name: Meat Beating: The Second Coming
games.desc: Seriously all you do is beat your meat.

games.name: Snow Problem
games.desc: A retro puzzle game with 100 levels ranging from easy to mind-bending, plus a built-in level editor to create your own brain-teasers.

games.name: Super Hamster Ball
games.desc: The cutest puzzle action game ever! Hamsters are so cute!

games.name: LIGHTNING
games.desc: Fast-paced competitive FPS with character abilities. Combining realistic settings with superpowers. Geared toward ESPORT with In-game Map Editor. Organize tournaments, customize weapons and characters, replay matches, manage your team, variety of modes and exclusive attention to gunplay.

games.name: pWordle
games.desc: pWordle - веселая головоломка, вдохновленная Wordle, доступная на русском языке. В ней есть виртуальная клавиатура, "Слово дня", режим Freeplay, музыкальный автомат, галерея. Разблокируйте изображения, улучшайте свой словарный запас и зарабатывайте достижения!

games.name: Splice
games.desc: A security job gone wrong. Now you are trapped with something deep inside an underground research bunker, and you are all that is left. Can you overcome your fear in this escape room horror?

games.name: Daemon Sigil
games.desc: Defend your village from an eldritch invasion in this creature collector, turn-based card battler. Train your favourite characters through a Roguelite upgrades system. Assemble a formidable daemon squad and journey to an otherworldly realm to close the last portal!

games.name: Lost Saga NA
games.desc: Part fighter, part brawler and made from pure awesomeness, Lost Saga is an action-packed beat-em-up styled game that will take your skills and push them to their max! Switch from over 60 heroes on the fly, letting you create an endless amount of combos!

games.name: Ошибка_Мальчик.exe (Error_Boy.exe)
games.desc: Из-за ошибки несколько игр смешались вместе! Это 2D bullet hell roguelike игра, в которой вы побеждаете врагов, используя предметы из разных игр вместе с "Error_Boy".

games.name: SpHero
games.desc: Вы - сфера, вы - герой, вы - SpHero! Завистливые тетраэдры и гексаэдры устали от вашего бизнеса без углов и решили захватить Сферию. Используйте свои сферические силы, чтобы преодолеть врагов и предстоящие испытания. Вы сможете катиться быстрее, подпрыгивать выше, бросать огненные шары или становиться катящимся…

games.name: Moxter
games.desc: Explore colonial Brazil on a unique off-road experience along the Estrada Real. You will be the Pilot transported to a time when the roads were traveled by muleteers and explorers, full of mysteries, gold and surprising encounters with historical figures from Minas Gerais.

games.name: Deepworld
games.desc: Deepworld is a massively-multiplayer 2D crafting adventure game. Mine and craft your way through a persistent online universe where there's always something new to discover. Battle frightening monsters, mysterious automatons, and other players in PvP!

games.name: Journey To The Center Of The Earth
games.desc: You love riddles and to combine logically? You love Jump 'n' Runs? You don't want to fight but you still want a challenge? Then you will love this Journey to the Center of the Earth! Control three adventurers with unique powers at the same time, or guide them individually in this narrative 2D puzzle platformer...

games.name: 玄戒修仙路：桃花天命
games.desc: A mystic ring opens your private Xumi realm, and with it a busy cultivation routine: fight, loot, build, break through, and challenge secret realms. Shape your path with gear, manuals, martial arts, artifacts, companions, and an abyss that refuses to mind its own business.

games.name: Metin2
games.desc: Станьте частью легендарной и захватывающей восточной ММО — теперь и в Steam! Покажите себя в эпических сражениях с драконами и зловещими князьями демонов, ведите беспощадные дуэли с другими игроками и станьте мастером боевых искусств!

games.name: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
games.desc: Start your own Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria with Freddy Fazbear Pizzeria Simulator!

games.name: WIDECROSS
games.desc: Wide Cross is a quick paced and easy-going MOBA, based on the premise of 5v5 player versus player combat. Play with an assortment of captivating characters and utilize boundless strategies to gain the advantage over your opponents - A compelling battlefield from beginning to end, will begin now!

games.name: MU Legend
games.desc: Following the footsteps of the successful titles MU Online and MU Origin, MU Legend offers an authentic alternative to the dungeon crawler gaming experience. A game with its own unique signature, MU Legend blends the dark fantasy world of an MMO with the richness of hack 'n' slash gaming.

games.name: Warhammer The Horus Heresy: Legions
games.desc: Собери колоду неукротимых космодесантников, чтобы завоевать галактику в жестоких поединках. Вновь переживи события «Ереси Гора» – оригинальной истории в мрачном будущем вселенной Warhammer 40000.

games.name: We Become What We Behold [Fan-Made Port]
games.desc: a game about news cycles, vicious cycles, infinite cycles

games.name: Операция: Пейнтбол
games.desc: Быстрый онлайн-шутер с реактивными рюкзаками, дельтапланами, быстрыми возрождениями, раундами в 6 минут и мгновенными матчами.

games.name: Mýrdalssandur, Iceland
games.desc: Experience a realistically inspired recreation of iceland's southern coast. Take photos and explore the world at your own pace, become immersed with some of the latest visual tech provided by Unreal Engine 4. *Please note DLC is required for VR!

games.name: Spirit of Adventure
games.desc: "Spirit of Adventure" is a classical 2.5D dungeon crawl RPG game in which you'll take charge of a group of adventurers searching for the next callenge.

games.name: MORTARMEN
games.desc: MORTARMEN is a strategic multiplayer PvP first and third person shooter, pitting the New American Coalition versus United Communist Front in a battle for control of Arakousa, a Mediterranean paradise, where soldiers traverse via sliding, rolling, climbing, and HALO drops.

games.name: Wetlands
games.desc: Beautifully animated with a mix of 3D and hand-drawn elements, this atmospheric sci-fi shooter features fast gameplay and a gritty story rich with sci-fi, film noir and cyberpunk overtones.

games.name: Saving Grace
games.desc: Хоррор от первого лица, вращающийся вокруг похищения вашей дочери Грейс. Культистам нужны жертвы, чтобы воскресить дьявола. Играйте за своего отца. Исследуйте прошлое, настоящее и будущее этой ужасающей интерактивной истории. Верните свою дочь ... Или объявите ад своим.

games.name: Shillelagh
games.desc: Shillelagh (Shil-lay-lah) is a fast and frantic arena shooter where players are armed with the aura of nature to defend against destructive, undead monsters.

games.name: Welcome To Lakewood
games.desc: Investigate the sleepy town of Lakewood as you follow the trail of numerous missing person cases and the mysterious cause of the disappearances. Unravel the secret of Lakewood and try to survive its tightening grip.

games.name: 孤胆惊魂2：消失的207（Fear 2: The Disappeared 207）
games.desc: This is a puzzle-solving, survival, adventure, survival, and horror shooting game I made. The viewing angle of the game is from a bird's-eye view, and you will control Yang Tian (the protagonist) Continue to survive the monster's attacks and seek the truth.

games.name: Valkyrie: Journey To Midgard
games.desc: Dragon Orb has been stolen from Asgard. Valkyrie has been sent down to Midgard to retrieve the lost treasure. The goddess must not only overcome fierce monsters, but also to face a dark conspiracy that will affect all of nine realms.

games.name: Miasma: Citizens of Free Thought
games.desc: Turn-based tactics in a dystopian future

games.name: DESKTOP MONKEY
games.desc: Сложная игра, в которой вы сражаетесь за лучшие места в таблице лидеров Steam. Живущая у вас на экране забавная обезьянка подготовит вас ко всему.

games.name: Swinging-Man
games.desc: Physics-based arcade game that will leave you in stitches and begging for more. Unleash your 'special web fluid' to swing across the city, defeat neuter drones, and collect adult magazines.

games.name: Hacker Man
games.desc: Joe, an experienced programmer at a reputable technology company, is fired by a director of the company, after having a romantic relationship with the director's wife. Very angry about the situation, Joe starts studying hacking, to get revenge for his firing.

games.name: CROPPED
games.desc: Cropped is a first-person action horror adventure - Survive the night as the farm you've arrived at has taken a turn for the worse...

games.name: Eaten by Darkness
games.desc: Fast paced mayhem in a hellish nightmare. Feel the dread of fear lingering nearby and the exhilaration of being chased by demons and undead in this bloody violent horror first person shooter. A detailed Unreal Engine 5 game utilizing advanced Nanite and Niagara graphics.

games.name: Book Travelers: A Victorian Story
games.desc: Can you save literature’s most famous story worlds from ruin?

games.name: Panic
games.desc: Panic is a single-player, horror game that puts you in the shoes of David, a young man who struggles with mental disorders. As you join him on his journey you will discover an immersive narrative experience that will stay with you long after you finish your journey.

games.name: Хуа Ся
games.desc: Играет в ролевую игру Huaxia. Боевой режим - это шахматы. Можно собирать ресурсы для производства оружия и реквизитов. Сыграл роль товарища - экспатрианта, выполнявшего задания на заброшенных землях Хуа Ся.

games.name: Coloring Game 5
games.desc: Coloring Game 5 – финальная часть франшизы, закрашивание по номерам. Является ярким представителем антистрессовых игр.

games.name: DOOMSDAY
games.desc: A fast-paced mad science roguelike deckbuilder. Build the ultimate doomsday device with cards, using controlled chaos and cunning play to your advantage. Defeat your puny enemies. Acquire priceless artifacts. Take over the world.

games.name: Might & Magic Heroes Online
games.desc: Игра «Меч и Магия: Герои Онлайн» — это обширный мир фэнтезийного Асхана: от шикарных замков Эльрата, Дракона Света до земель Нар-Эриша!

games.name: Firefly Online Cortex
games.desc: The Cortex is your ultimate destination for Firefly Online news and information. This companion app is a great way to stay current with the game’s progress, take advantage of special offers and gain access to exclusive content!

games.name: Bloodwood Reload
games.desc: In a small village in central Europe something is happening, the forest growing around has something different. Its wood is red color, unique in the world. This does not pass unnoticed to the world's largest logging company, the White Wood Company

games.name: Rustbucket Rumble
games.desc: Rustbuckle Rumble is a side-scrolling, team-based, arena combat game - WITH ROBOTS! Inspiration for the mechanics was taken from classic run and gun games mixed with more modern, class-based, multiplayer shooters. It’s capture-the-flag where the players are the flags.

games.name: Tap Tap Infinity
games.desc: Tap Tap Infinity is a fully 3D incremental RPG. Hire Heroes to fight for you, even with the game closed! Gain unimaginable DPS, mountains of gold, conquer thousands of levels and millions of monsters on your quest to defeat ‘The Master'.

games.name: Clover Tale
games.desc: На долину Ниффлингов надвигается загадочная черная тень. Все взволнованы и никто не понимает, что происходит. Помогите Ниффлингам спасти свой дом в захватывающей матч-3 игре!

games.name: Toricky
games.desc: Toricky is an old-school Action-Adventure game featuring unique mechanics based on fast-flying and physics. Explore immense 2D Zones, and defeat gigantic Bosses, to save the Crystar Palace!

games.name: Странник Теандрии
games.desc: Wanderer of Teandria - непростой 2D платформер, вдохновленный классическими представителями жанра. Собирайте кристаллы и фрагменты карты, избегайте врагов и ловушек, и побеждайте гигантских боссов, чтобы добиться успеха на пути к вашей судьбе!

games.name: Cook & Click
games.desc: Игра по управлению рестораном: нарезайте ингредиенты, открывайте новые категории и заведения. Автоматизируйте производство, покупайте улучшения, увеличивайте прибыль, открывайте навыки и достижения. Захватывающий игровой процесс, который не заставит вас оторваться.

games.name: Aliens: Colonial Marines Collection
games.desc: Вы с друзьями — самые смертельно опасные убийцы в галактике, колониальные морпехи США. От вас требуется не просто выжить, но и уничтожить очаг распространения ксеноморфов.

games.name: Supremacy: Call of War 1942
games.desc: Вторая мировая война: танковые баталии, морские сражения, воздушные схватки. В игре Call of War вы переписываете ход истории! Возглавьте одну из могущественных наций во время второй мировой войны. Завоевывайте регионы, заключайте альянсы и развивайте экономику.

games.name: Buried Alive VR
games.desc: Your worst nightmare just became reality - you are buried alive! There is no room for panic, you need to act quickly in order to survive. The coffin is full of different riddles and puzzles you need to solve to find your way out.

games.name: CRSED: Cuisine Royale
games.desc: CRSED: Cuisine Royale — брутальный ММО-шутер на выживание с реалистичным оружием, элементами кровавой мистики и невероятными сверхспособностями.

games.name: Coloring Game 2
games.desc: Coloring Game 2 – продолжение полюбившейся многим раскраски по номерам. Добавлены новые функции и картинки.

games.name: ANARCHY
games.desc: ANARCHY - это игра на выживание и побег. Орда роботов, ловушек и прочего попытается убить вас. Сейчас это одна из самых сложных игр в STEAM.

games.name: Ohayou! Beginner's Japanese
games.desc: Ohayou! Beginner’s Japanese is an educational game that will teach you the basics of Japanese Hiragana and Katakana.

games.name: FPV SkyDive : FPV Drone Simulator
games.desc: FPV SkyDive is a free-to-play realistic drone racing and freestyle simulator. Feel the adrenaline of high speed first-person view drone racing in single-player or multi-player scenarios. The future is now, become an FPV pilot today!

games.name: Virtual Cottage
games.desc: Virtual Cottage gives you a comfy place to rest and be productive without any distractions. Open the game, set yourself a goal and enjoy the atmosphere.

games.name: Rescue Rover Collection
games.desc: This classic pair of whimsical and challenging grid-based action puzzle games are now available together in one package! Rescue your dog Rover from evil robots across two full games by solving fiendishly complex environmental puzzles to retrieve your beloved pup and make it safely back home.

games.name: Pegasus: Broken Wings
games.desc: Follow a new set of events involving Pegasus-5 crew with them being stuck in a city under curfew after a terrorist attack and getting entangled in a massive conspiracy. Stick close to your allies, build romantic relations, and make important choices.

games.name: R is for Rachel
games.desc: A romance about falling in love for the first time, while suffering from social anxiety disorder.

games.name: ToyCar
games.desc: Race around tracks in small cars with your friends. Use the boost to pass them and leave them in the dust. But be mindful of the temperature, we do not want the engine to go boom are we?

games.name: Neon Racer
games.desc: Endless road, neon lights, palm trees. The game immerses you in the atmosphere of retrowave. Welcome to Neon Racer! Neon Racer is a car simulator game in which you drive along the endless road and avoid other cars.

games.name: Mosaics Galore. Glorious Journey
games.desc: По следам чудес. Славное приключение. 100 магических мозаик уже ждут тебя!

games.name: Pox Nora
games.desc: Delve into classic turn-based strategy gaming with elements of table top miniatures, fantasy RPG and TCG style gameplay all wrapped into one.

games.name: Rev Up! RC Grand Prix
games.desc: It's time to rev up, and race your way to the title of RC Grand Prix Champion!

games.name: ROSE Online
games.desc: We don't know where Arua came from, nor how she came to be. We do know, however, that nothing existed before Arua.

games.name: Portal 2 Sixense Perceptual Pack
games.desc: Portal 2 Sixense Perceptual Pack is a free stand-alone game, developed with the Intel Perceptual Computing SDK, custom-designed for exclusive use with the Creative Senz3D depth and gesture camera, which is required to play this title. Portal 2 is not required to play Portal 2 Sixense Perceptual Pack.

games.name: Guild of Rogues
games.desc: "Guild of Rogues" - это колодостроитель с элементами рогалика и автобаттлера. Стратегически собирайте команду приспешников, чтобы создать удивительные синергии и победить всех врагов!

games.name: Cursed Dawn
games.desc: Cursed Dawn - это FPS-выживалка с полными секретов сложными картами, динамическим спавном и полчищами зомби, которых нужно ебашить в кашу. Планируйте оборону, будьте в движении и изучайте карты. Помните: нигде не безопасно, смерть гарантирована. Как долго вы сможете избегать её?

games.name: Terror Mansion
games.desc: Terror Mansion is an exciting first person Horror video game that catapults you into a frightening Mansion. Your main objective is to escape the infested Mansion, finding objects and challenging riddles while exploring incredible scenarios.

games.name: Primrows
games.desc: A challenging game of logic, luck, and pattern recognition that adds a twist of chance to sudoku mechanics. Tend to a whimsical garden with organic sounds and visuals while you unearth new weekly challenges that introduce special mechanics.

games.name: From The Mystery Zone
games.desc: You find yourself in a pitch-dark world. Avoid dangerous events, restore memory, and escape from the “Mystery Zone”.

games.name: Puzzle Dungeon!! Earthmage Erin
games.desc: Puzzle Dungeon!! is a series of games where fantasy classes solve puzzles themed after their abilities! In Puzzle Dungeon!!: Earthmage Erin, play as Erin, an Earthmage with the power to control gravity. Solve 30+ puzzles in themed dungeons to rescue Erin's lost goats and bring them back to her farm.

games.name: Witch's Brew: Love and Lattes
games.desc: Will you spill the tea about the secret, cozy magical cafe on your college campus? Brew potions and romance on coffee dates with your new friends! A text-based novel of magic and romance, with hundreds of choices and without graphics or sound effects.

games.name: Battle for Blood - Epic battles within 30 seconds!
games.desc: Constant fun and excitement! Bloody fighting from the start. Epic battles within 30 seconds. An all-new game type is coming!

games.name: Empires Of Creation
games.desc: Take on the role of fleet commander and lead your empire to victory. Conquer enemies in high octane battles to upgrade your ships and gain credits for use on the galactic market. Exploit your relations with friends and foes to establish a monopoly over your corner of the universe.

games.name: Epic Clicker Journey
games.desc: Experience your epic journey. Discover 20 mysterious lands and face the monsters living out there. Show that you are persistent traveler and held your adventure, even in the toughest conditions.

games.name: Galaxy Control: 3D Strategy
games.desc: Находясь под неусыпным взором многочисленных врагов, необходимо построить свой космический блок-пост, собрать галактические войска, в которые будут входить боевые роботы и машины, военные пушки. Начните войну с коварными врагами.

games.name: Kritika:REBOOT
games.desc: Kritika:REBOOT is a hyper-stylized, anime brawler game featuring over-the-top action with giant blades, superguns, and dazzling acrobatics. Fight with friends or rampage solo through hordes of enemies and super-sized bosses in an epic fantasy world.

games.name: Fantasy Tales Online
games.desc: Fantasy Tales Online is a retro MMORPG where you must form parties, collect gear, fight through dungeons and defeat bosses. Featuring puzzles, a rich item system and complex encounters. This isn’t your run-of-the-mill grindfest MMO title!

games.name: 爪爪改造家2 PawRebuild 2
games.desc: Five animal friends turn messy ruins into a cozy haven by matching identical items. It features 10 scenes with 5 renovation stages for each, adopts a distinctive cardboard art style, has no time limits or penalty mechanics, and allows you to unlock all achievements effortlessly.

games.name: Resurgence
games.desc: When his daughter Rosie goes missing after a car crash, Jason Dawn thinks his debts with the mob have come back to haunt him. His past leads him to a final confrontation where Jason learns the terrible truth.

games.name: Ludu
games.desc: Ludu (« ash » in breton) is a free adventure game created with RPG Maker 2003.

games.name: Invictus: In the Shadow of Olympus
games.desc: Caught in a bitter feud between spiteful gods, you fight for more than your life in this strategy RPG. Enlist Hercules, Achilles, Electra and the mightiest of heroes in your struggle for an eternal seat atop Olympus. Create your own war host from over 30 distinct units.

games.name: Slapshot
games.desc: Slapshot is an online multiplayer game where you and 5 other players play a game of hockey. The game is physics-based, so teamwork and crisp passing are essential to win. Play with your friends or team up with other Slapshot players!

games.name: Azure Sky Project
games.desc: A Tactical 2D Shooter where the player has complete freedom on how to tackle missions. Engage in our 15 hand-built campaign missions or farm up some money in our randomly generated "Freelance Work" missions using the gear and strategies that YOU choose!

games.name: NO LOVE
games.desc: A hard scifi, fantasy, hand-drawn RPG with a unique original story that’s mainly about the characters and delves into topics regarding the human condition from the perspective of one person, Wallace Lovecraft.

games.name: Ultimate Custom Night
games.desc: Welcome to the ultimate FNAF mashup, featuring 50 selectable characters and custom difficulties!

games.name: The Path To Die
games.desc: Travel to Feudal Japan and use your right stick as your katana to slay your enemies in this action and adventure game represented in pixel art and top down view.

games.name: PROP AND SEEK®
games.desc: Prop and seek is a hide and seek game which up to 32 players take turns to hide or seek. You can be a prop to hide or be a hunter to find all hidden props.

games.name: Super Bernie World
games.desc: Join Bernie's movement and transform the United States in this free retro 2D platformer.

games.name: Brothers in Blood: WW2
games.desc: Wage war across some of the most iconic battles in WWII. Featuring exciting cooperative action with up to eight players and a feeling of large scale combat.

games.name: Geki Yaba Runner
games.desc: Стань неукротимой силой разрушения или сверхбыстрым гномом, чтобы преодолеть главное испытание Geki Yaba. Хватит ли тебе смелости спасти принцессу?

games.name: SiN Episodes: Emergence
games.desc: Вы — Джон Блэйд, командир HardCorps — элитной службы безопасности, защищающей людей города Фрипорт. Прошло четыре года со времен вашей битвы с Элексис Синклер, прекрасной, гениальной, но совершенно безжалостной ученой, которая хотела переделать человечество согласно собственным представлениям об идеале.

games.name: First Hero - Epic of Gilgamesh
games.desc: "First Hero" is a third person hack 'n' slash, based on the epic of Gilgamesh: the holdest in our history. With an enormous strenght, various weapons and combinations you'll face a lot of soldiers, beasts, traps, demons and even the gods, during your quest to become immortal.

games.name: 剑决
games.desc: 3d duel fight support local multiplayer.

games.name: #Snake2 DX: Reawakening
games.desc: Explosive, balls-to-the-wall bullet hell shooter with novel shooting mechanics (and surreal comedy)

games.name: Bus stop in the fog
games.desc: A bus trip is a journey not a destination. You bought your first boat with your savings of the last 5 years and you find yourself stranded on an island in the Bermuda sea. You must take a very scary bus ride to get off the island ... but will the bus take you off the island?

games.name: Sabre Team
games.desc: Sabre Team is an isometric squad-level turn-based infiltration simulation that lets you assemble and take command of a Sabre Team unit of four hand-picked elite S.A.S. agents as they confront delicate and dangerous scenarios involving terrorist threats and hostage situations.

games.name: Am Madness
games.desc: Your Omega protection has been stolen. Attempt to escape the first signs of madness, in a hard, unforgiving, 2D platformer. Inspired by classics such as Manic Miner and Jet Set Willy. Face the darkness, escape the madness.

games.name: 骑士王的荣耀 Honor of Knight King
games.desc: Honor of Knight King — action RPG от третьего лица. Сражайся в лесной арене с армиями тёмного мага: парируй удары, отвечай контрударами, круши толпы эффектными AoE-умениями, становись сильнее и пробей путь к Великому Тёмному Волшебнику — чтобы ночь снова стала спокойной.

games.name: Elemgate
games.desc: Elemgate - это уникальный высокоточный платформер, в котором вам нужно контролировать свою скорость, совершать прыжки и менять элементы, чтобы заработать больше времени, которое необходимо для прохождения 10 этапов на каждом из 16 уровней на 2,5D полосе препятствий, чтобы спастись от злого бога.

games.name: MOLOGA
games.desc: Description: in 1935, the leadership of the USSR decided to build a new reservoir in one of the regions of the republic. Almost all people left villages and towns, but some refused to leave their homes.

games.name: House of the Soul
games.desc: Begin a journey of deception and discovery in 'HOUSE OF THE SOUL', a first-person exploration and story based experience. Explore an isolated mansion and descend into its lower levels as you discover the hidden secret project of the obsessive inventor who lives there.

games.name: Folktale
games.desc: Enter a magical realm and become a hero in this 3rd person fantasy RPG combat rogue-like game. Explore ever-changing worlds, battle fearsome monsters. Made by one person.

games.name: After the Flood
games.desc: Embark on a chilling journey into the heart of a desolate town trapped in the clutches of an ancient curse. "After the Flood" is a single-player horror game that combines atmospheric exploration, immersive storytelling, and heart-pounding survival elements.

games.name: Champions of Regnum
games.desc: Choose your Realm and engage in the most dynamic player driven battlefield available on any MMO. Fight for the Alsius Empire, protect the woods of Syrtis or avenge the Brotherhood of Ignis.

games.name: Jump Up, Jerry!
games.desc: Подпрыгивай, Джерри! — это аркадный платформер, в котором вы должны прыгать через различные типы канатных дорог и врагов, чтобы набрать наибольшее количество очков.

games.name: Soldier Front 2
games.desc: Across any terrain, with any weapon, against any opponent—the war must go on! Test your prowess with modern first-person shooter action in intense warzones ranging from labyrinthine urban locales to dusty desert battlefields. The gear, combat, and settings are designed to create an exceedingly realistic and…

games.name: Animal Kostume
games.desc: No talk, compadre. It's Animal Kostume time! Follow kroc-boy in his path to overcome a series of difficult levels in this hardcore 2D platformer with a lot of enemies, bullets and surprises.

games.name: Color Splash: Animals
games.desc: Color Splash: Animals is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable animals and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful animal paintings.

games.name: Don't Leave
games.desc: Welcome to a mysterious adventure where justice and the supernatural intertwine! Judge Harlan, in his old country cottage, faces a mysterious presence after his mother's sudden departure. Explore justice's limits in this extraordinary tale!

games.name: BattleClaws
games.desc: Experience the ultimate local multiplayer claw 'em up! Battle for glory in this fast-paced arcade elimination game. Collect prizes for points, outlast your rivals, and be the last claw standing. Dominate the leaderboard and prove you’re the ultimate BattleClaws champion!

games.name: Nightgate
games.desc: В 2398 году сеть разумных компьютеров под названием Nightgate стала последней формой жизни на Земле. Войдите в компьютер и откройте то, что скрывается за футуристическими пейзажами Nightgate.

games.name: Moth Cry
games.desc: “Moth Сry” - нелинейная визуальная новелла, о жизни и ее последствиях. Проживите жизнь вместе с главным героем. Его судьба в ваших руках.

games.name: Lost Dreams
games.desc: Выжить в авиакатастрофе было лишь началом. Теперь тебе предстоит найти способ сбежать с острова и выжить среди странных существ, что его населяют. Управляй боеприпасами, выживай и исследуй в этом ужасающем приключении.

games.name: WARRIORS
games.desc: Warriors — это современный многопользовательский шутер, который сочетает захватывающий реализм с адреналиновым экшеном. Игра разработана для игроков всех уровней и позволяет сражаться с реальными противниками или бросать вызов продвинутым ботам в одиночном режиме. В игре представлено семь игровых режимов

games.name: Teddy Roller 1
games.desc: Join Teddy on his sprawling adventure as he navigates treacherous paths and impossible hurdles. Traverse over 60 unique stages, that are sure to test even the most experienced player`s determination. Strange creatures pop up on the way, that seek to deter his plight in this retro-inspired game.

games.name: Subzero Stealth
games.desc: Airdropped into a snowbound village under siege, you’re the lone soldier facing relentless enemies and harsh conditions. Navigate deadly terrain, combat armed foes and destroy critical targets. Master the battlefield where death is ever-present. Will you survive? The challenge awaits.

games.name: Escape From Infection Zone
games.desc: Покиньте зону заражения зомби, используя арсенал оружия, в этой игре-стрелялке на арене.

games.name: TDP4: Team Battle
games.desc: TDP4: Team Battle - ураганный 2D онлайн-шутер c элементами MMORPG. Вам предстоит сразиться и отстоять свою честь в битве с другими игроками. Разнообразные игровые режимы, широкий выбор амуниции, игровых карт, гибкая система улучшения персонажей уж точно не заставит вас скучать!

games.name: Fields of Mine
games.desc: Fields of Mine — рогалик-головоломка, где классический сапёр превращается в непредсказуемое приключение. Каждый уровень меняет правила, бросая вызов твоей логике, внимательности и умению адаптироваться.

games.name: Uebergame
games.desc: A truly free and open source multiplayer shooter, no strings attached. Have casual deathmatch matches on various scenarios. Build your own levels with the ingame editor and assets that come with the game, or just play around and use it as a sandbox.

games.name: Idle Squire
games.desc: Idle Squire is a desktop idle roguelite RPG where every key you press is an attack. Type, browse, or work while your squire clears dungeons, finds loot, and grows stronger. Unlock talents, artifacts, and perks that bring speed, power, and even partial automation.

games.name: Road Less Traveled
games.desc: A horror camping open-world survival game where you drive from campsite to campsite, scavenge, craft gear, upgrade your RV, and manage hunger, fuel, sleep, and sanity to escape the forest alive. This is a permadeath game—if you die, you lose your progress and start over.

games.name: Datacenter Simulator
games.desc: A hands-on, first-person datacenter tycoon. Order hardware, haul the boxes, rack the servers, patch every cable and subnet every switch then keep it all online through power cuts, heatwaves and hardware failures as your empire grows.

games.name: Echo Tower
games.desc: Reach the top of a tower plunged into darkness using the power of echolocation. Echo Tower is an audio dungeon-crawler where your ears replace your eyes. Navigate through the floors, solve puzzles, avoid traps, defend yourself and bring back the light to the planet.

games.name: Venture Forth
games.desc: Venture Forth is an extremely challenging adventure game with a retro 90s shooter vibe. Forge your own path within its labyrinthine caves but beware the danger lurking around every corner.

games.name: Bloodline Champions
games.desc: Bloodline Champions is a Free-to-Play online PvP Arena game where players engage in short, intense battles of up to ten players divided into two teams. Each player takes control over one of several bloodlines, each with their own unique weapons and abilities. Easy to learn, challenging to master.

games.name: OLDTV
games.desc: Можете ли вы подумать два раза за секунду?

games.name: SUPREMACY: WORLD WAR 3
games.desc: Возглавьте вооруженные силы своей страны. Определите направление военной экспансии, приоритет научных исследований и темпы экономического развития. Найдите союзников и сразитесь за власть над миром на полях Третьей мировой войны.

games.name: Tactical Mind
games.desc: Become a Master of Pawns with your Tactical Mind!

games.name: Tank raid
games.desc: Головокружительный танковый раннер. Проверьте себя на стойкость, участвуя в сражении с танками и авиацией противника. Случайная генерация противников по ходу вашего продвижения сделает каждый новый бой уникальным и непредсказуемым.

games.name: Winter Magic Factory
games.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy your stay in Santa's village in this match-3 adventure.

games.name: Grimm's Hollow
games.desc: Лаванда, проснувшись этим утром, не ожидала, что окажется в окружении толпы взволнованных незнакомцев, облачённых в маски в форме черепов, в руках держащих торт и шарики. Всё же, это ведь не был её день рождения; и это не был её дом.

games.name: Bloons Monkey City
games.desc: Create, upgrade, and customize your very own Bloons Monkey City in this groundbreaking blend of city building and tower defense awesomeness!

games.name: Pity Pit
games.desc: Dig Dug meets Downwell! Dig your doom, save Gwendoline from the Devil Johnson! 2D platforming, digging, ores, crafting, bombs!!

games.name: Nexagon: Deathmatch
games.desc: Unfolding in the fourth millennium, this is a real-time, 3D, action-packed game of mortal arena combat that emphasizes tactics and features advancement and fortress building in a high stakes blood sport. Battle for freedom in a televised tournament in a completely destructible environment.

games.name: Sport Shooter
games.desc: Sport Shooter puts the player in a sprawling open-world shooting ground, set amongst the rolling hills, forests, lakes and rivers of the Northern English countryside, featuring a multitude of shooting sports, from clay pigeons, to timed 3-gun competitions.

games.name: Hunted
games.desc: A survival horror game where you must survive inside a deep, dark cave with no clear way out. Hunting you is a hungry cave bear. Using your ears alone, you must keep your paltry lantern's light alive by collecting oil, and if you're lucky, you might get out with the help of your trusty shotgun.

games.name: Unlimited Fight
games.desc: Fighting game developed in the best 3d style, with simple commands and easy to learn even for those who do not play fighting games, but with a variety of movements and combos that can be applied. are you ready for action?

games.name: Retro Run
games.desc: Retro Run is a synthwave aesthetic platformer that offers a fun, but challenging twist to the arcade shooter genre.

games.name: Höll Space 5D6
games.desc: Each episode puts you in control of a different protagonist in an open, nonlinear maze and world who has to figure out the secrets of Höll Space to survive.

games.name: Endless Thief: a Fluffy Stealth Adventure
games.desc: You're a master thief in this ambient animal stealth game. You sneak past any guard, pick any lock, break into and steal from any secured building. Guards see, hear, speak and chase. Observe and prepare the best plan. Ghost unseen in shadows, distract, stalk, trap or knock out and hide guards.

games.name: Solitaire Victorian Picnic 2
games.desc: 120 аристократичных раскладов ждут тебя! Посети Викторианскую Англию!

games.name: Cosmophage
games.desc: Cosmophage is a procedurally generated bullet hell platformer with a boundless world and infinitely varied weapon drops. Defeat enough enemies and collect their life energy to achieve ultimate victory, but beware - the more you destroy, the meaner they get.

games.name: The Legend of Gandar
games.desc: The Legend of Gandar is an action-adventure video game. The player slips into the legend of Gandar, in the role of the farm boy. He woke up one day and received a strange letter, and so begins the story of a boy.

games.name: Nora's AdventurEscape
games.desc: Do you seek an adventure? Maybe an escape from daily struggles? Find hidden objects, solve puzzles and escape rooms.

games.name: S E V E R A N C E
games.desc: Years after the Overflow, a catastrophe that plunged the city of Sci-Two into a decaying metropolis, a wayward smuggler stumbles into a plot surrounding the miracle drug Halcyon, veteran soldiers, and the corporation out to eradicate anyone too close to the truth, in a classic JRPG experience.

games.name: Volunteer
games.desc: Experience first-person horror and fight to survive in a chaotic landscape infested with bloodthirsty creatures.

games.name: Fly to hope
games.desc: Fly to hope is a platformer action game. Use your shotgun and machete to overcome enemies. Fight with strong bosses and collect 3 missing part of your aircraft.

games.name: STARR RINGER
games.desc: Grab the fate of all life in your hands. Blast your way through the cosmos, destroying monstrous cosmic beasts and the space cultists summoning them, on your path to stopping your mother from unleashing the chaos realm upon the universe, in this sci-fi cosmic horror bullet-hell, STARR RINGER.

games.name: 抵御者 Defender
games.desc: This is a simple fighting game. You only need to press 3 buttons to experience easy battles. The original intention of this game is to bring the most simple and refreshing feeling of combat.

games.name: Safari Pinball
games.desc: Take a Safari through Africa in the most entertaining Pinball!

games.name: Doozie the Unicorn
games.desc: Doozie the Unicorn, a Gothic, Dark Fantasy, Medieval, Action, Adventure, Fairy-Tale.

games.name: Lethal Operation Episode1 Healer Rugittaリーサルオペレーション ルギッタ編
games.desc: キャラをじっくり育てながら広い世界を冒険する――。 そんなSTGがあってもいいじゃないか!! …というのがこのゲームのコンセプト。 ブレイクによって敵弾を消すことができ、 レベルと装備で強くなるので、STGが苦手な人でも凶悪弾幕ボスを間違いなく倒せるようになります!

games.name: The book of death for dummies
games.desc: Death has taken a well-deserved vacation in Cancun and left George in charge! He'll have to learn to deal with Destiny and decide who should continue their journey in the land of the living. But beware, wrong choices lead to undesirable consequences!

games.name: The House
games.desc: The House is a new first-person horror and psychological game for the computer. Escape the house where it all began, collect items, weapons and level up. Travel between worlds and time to reach your goal. Go discover the dark secrets of the House where it all began!

games.name: 第九竞技场
games.desc: Welcome to the AUTO-CARD Competition of The Ninth Universe. You can show your skills, enter a higher level of competition, and strive to win the glory of the universe championship.

games.name: Flashman Gold
games.desc: Flashman, Flashman Gold he is called because he is a super fast gold smith.Now his gold has been stolen by gold stealing monsters thieves and now there is only one thing to do, get the gold back!!! 30 beautiful levels, especially for people who have experienced the 80'

games.name: Worldcrusher - a survival clicker game
games.desc: Путешествуйте в космосе и скрафтите другие планеты, чтобы восстановить свою родную планету в этой простой ролевой игре-кликере.

games.name: Star Swarm Stress Test

Star Swarm is a real-time demo of Oxide Games’ Nitrous engine, which pits two AI-controlled fleets against each other in a furious…

games.name: Pixel Pete
games.desc: Pixel Pete is an action-packed platformer game where you play as the intrepid Pixel Pete. Armed with a trusty FISH GUN, additional weaponry, and a talking cardboard cutout that only he can see and hear, as he embarks on a mission to collapse the multiverse and find his way back home.

games.name: Square of Joy
games.desc: Climb up, reach the top, using nothing but your skill and will. Compete with steam friends and players from all over the world. Discover secrets along the way.

games.name: DEAD GET REKT
games.desc: In the shadow-drenched realm where modern warfare intertwines with necromantic horrors, we have conjured an unparalleled adventure. Forge your arsenal from an evolving deck of cards, face legions of the undead delvers, unearth artifacts of might and vanquish the darkness that festers down the Crypt!

games.name: Inspiring Dreams - A Short Adventure Game
games.desc: A story-driven experience about a man who becomes a ghost after a deadly accident. Full of regrets, he will stay alongside his wife, who cannot see him, and protect her all her life from an unknown evil, sharing her best and worst moments. So close yet so far.

games.name: Valor & Blade
games.desc: Souls-Inspired Dungeon Crawler. End the Cycle. Master the Blade.

games.name: Divine Souls F2P MMO

Explore a massive campaign, solo or co-op. Hop online for epic 32 player battles or fast paced 1v1, on 100s of maps.

games.name: Spartans Vs Zombies Defense

games.name: Complex 629

Общайтесь с многочисленными персонажами, собирая деньги и полезные предметы для перемещения между заснеженными квартирами

games.name: YUKOMON
